#
Friend of Life,

As you may have seen, Hurricane Helene has ravaged multiple states, destroying entire communities and leaving millions of people in desperate need.

We are praying for those impacted by the storm, and as pro-life people, we are responding to the need. [ ](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=3fd84d1fcbf14127807972ab077a1da0&_e=2Bupgwy7tcA1SoQY9LgaDs-w5m6MskTb4qxzjEOOFHmdCk8Mw2nEATf-F0UtEJBmJ2e022GqlucF67iEMIlhogaIyQ0iQWoBh8rdMSw3117EKI7Y4u7XuI5sJGaLAcxbOv_MQ19iEs1gZX16W9aq8qas7SW-R3Ae8jgCyLz9Ft4wp9aH-JPBWVnjcFCDMxlbW-77OCrL8C2ISTniBkWhvNfuXnoykFH6H0WBmH7Xz53Ra7y38hSocfJfGclPXaWUAm9BWImu4zsDLni71IIJ42vj_BWys8z3zl18mvKeauIKU0UesAJCUUiuLQwW0jV7ujE42umgnBB2KMqnefwR6XmSvAej0WqV58HuztV3PitN2Skhr41KZ83qWEcw22BY)
Many families are currently stranded - without access to power, food, water, or resources.

Live Action is partnering with EveryLife which is working with churches, rescue teams, and pregnancy resource centers in the area to ensure that families who desperately need diapers receive them in time.

**You can make a direct impact now and help mothers and babies. Will you join Live Action and EveryLife by responding today to those impacted by the hurricane? Your gift of $50 enables us to send a box containing six packs of EveryLife diapers.**

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Angry and adrift, at the mercy of his whims, Trump campaign spokesperson lashes out at me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by ECU Non-federal
body:
| [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/26910?t=1&akid=22217%2E4449941%2EYFFqlX)
---
Team — you can hear the spitting anger and desperation from Donald Trump’s campaign in their increasingly desperate attacks.

As they frantically search for _something,**anything**_ they can tether to a coherent campaign message with time running out until this election, they picked a familiar target — yours truly. “**Shifty Schiff** has no right to talk about morals, considering he’s one of the most **despicable** and **disgusting** elected officials in Congress.” All because I called Trump out on _CNN_ for flip-flopping on the fundamental right to abortion — no less than 4 times in _48 hours_. **His willingness to change his stance every 15 minutes on a matter this serious shows that in addition to opposing women’s reproductive freedoms, he has no moral compass or values at all. He only believes in his own self ‐interest.**

But as Trump’s spokesperson saw it, that wasn’t an indictment of their candidate, but of those willing to confront him — the same old story for Trump’s entire political career.

**I’m used to the attacks from Trump personally, team. And now, I need your help to respond to his campaign flacks. Every time he and his team come after me, their insults and lies multiply through their right-wing echo chambers and risk having voters believe them.**

Team, the Trump campaign is backed into a corner. They are lashing out because they cannot do anything else. Their candidate has no values, no morals, and, we hope, is on the verge of his final defeat. [**Chip in a split donation right now between Fight for Reform to help them elect state and local Democrats and my campaign to help send me to the Senate and finish the job of defeating him by electing California’s Kamala Harris as our next president. ## One day left to register to vote!

Dear Friends, Time is running out! Tomorrow, October 6th, is the final day to register to vote or update your voter registration here in Alaska. This is crucial for a couple of reasons:
1. **Not Registered Yet?** If you haven’t registered yet, you MUST do so by tomorrow at [https://voterregistration.alaska.gov/](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=9a91c4c94e&e=6679001ba0) to be eligible to vote in the November 5th election. Missing this deadline means losing your voice in this important election!
2. **Moved Recently?** If you've moved and haven’t updated your registration, you might face restrictions when voting. If you’ve relocated from one state district to another, please make sure your current address is on file with the Division of Elections. Failure to update your registration could limit you to statewide races only, and if the Division of Elections has marked your status as “inactive,” you may have to vote using a questioned ballot. Avoid the hassle by updating your registration today at [https://voterregistration.alaska.gov/](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=36c22961f8&e=6679001ba0).

**Please take a moment to check your registration status, and while you’re at it, reach out to your friends and neighbors**. Let’s make sure everyone is registered and ready to vote! Additionally, our campaign needs your help! [Join us](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=77577abafa&e=6679001ba0) in canvassing and phone banking to spread the word about our message for Alaska. Together, we can make a difference this November. Thank you for your continued support. **America First, Fighting for Alaska!**

Onward to victory,

Nick Begich
Candidate for U.S. Congress
\---

P.S. If you haven’t already, please consider supporting our campaign. Every bit of help makes a huge difference in ensuring that Alaskans have the representation they deserve. [Chip in today](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=f0cb95a3b6&e=6679001ba0) and be a part of the team that will deliver for Alaska and America.

See, I didn't earn their support with false promises, _[or even flashy TikToks](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94391577/503367006/-1496313371?_t=8pVCYUmFRl9&_r=1&refcode=jtk2142-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDRhYjhkZmEtOGM4My1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=8A5fE8WpLNbHGwXIKXhTO7roEXtpjF4FCbBa1ua3Pdo=&emci=760e755b-1f81-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=04ab8dfa-8c83-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=3969733)_ — **I'm filling lecture halls and tailgates because my people-first message aligns with their priorities.**
**They care about reproductive rights:** Young women want the right to choose what they do with their own bodies. Young men don’t want to worry about their partners’ health. And they _all_ want to protect access to contraception options and the extra level of safety it provides.
**They care about strengthening gun control:** College is stressful enough as it is. The last thing students need to worry about is finding the nearest exit in case a shooter enters the dining hall or the classroom.
**They care about the affordability crisis:** Working families across Florida are already struggling to make ends meet — and for students looking ahead to repaying thousands in student loans after graduation, while home ownership already seems out of reach and rents are on the rise, something's got to give.
**They care about education:** Florida's students have stood on the frontlines of the GOP's extremist crackdowns on the freedom to speak, learn, and live freely. They're sick of the book bans, the fear-mongering, the propaganda, and the division — and they're not afraid to confront ugly truths.
**They care about the climate:** Sea levels are rising, and parts of our state are sinking. As our students work hard to carve a path to a brighter future, they're grappling with the fear that unless we act now, there might not even be a _liveable_ future to look forward to here in Florida.
**_TL;DR:_** Florida's young voters aren't so different from any other generation. They care about everyone's future — and their idealism, courage, and energy inspire me every day to keep up the fight for Florida, even when the going gets tough.

clean_body: fighting today for Florida's tomorrow | | | So far along my travels across Florida, I have to admit, friend: The college stops have been some of my favorites. = It's always inspiring to connect with young voters and future leaders. But running a challenger campaign on the road isn't always easy, so it's especially encouraging to know that I've won the cool kids' support. = | | = See, I didn't earn their support with false promises, — I'm filling lecture halls and tailgates because my people-first message aligns with their priorities. They care about reproductive rights: Young women want the right to choose what they do with their own bodies. Young men don’t want to worry about their partners’ health. And they all want to protect access to contraception options and the extra level of safety it provides. They care about strengthening gun control: College is stressful enough as it is. The last thing students need to worry about is finding the nearest exit in case a shooter enters the dining hall or the classroom. They care about the affordability crisis: Working families across Florida are already struggling to make ends meet — and for students looking ahead to repaying thousands in student loans after graduation, while home ownership already seems out of reach and rents are on the rise, something's got to give. They care about education: Florida's students have stood on the frontlines of the GOP's extremist crackdowns on the freedom to speak, learn, and live freely. They're sick of the book bans, the fear-mongering, the propaganda, and the division — and they're not afraid to confront ugly truths. They care about the climate: Sea levels are rising, and parts of our state are sinking. As our students work hard to carve a path to a brighter future, they're grappling with the fear that unless we act now, there might not even be a liveable future to look forward to here in Florida. TL;DR: Florida's young voters aren't so different from any other generation. They care about everyone's future — and their idealism, courage, and energy inspire me every day to keep up the fight for Florida, even when the going gets tough. name: Hillsdale College via Updates For Great Americans
subject: Help us understand CRT’s influence
body:
I’m reaching out because you’re an informed patriot who cares about this country.

This sponsored message from Updates for Great Americans is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zt82qmqumjqq4sd9rcutltfne33qdlsq4cuhq2fo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s9g6ep70cph2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zndlfrq63i1ee28kefvur4a457stlu9q48osuvdg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s9g6ep70cph2bs)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6350bf8e44084876bffd587aa805f298&_e=xYvMFZHZCsolqawEFpcxorSSeyABMqY7eyNJaPk9sqQb8TvHJIWoewB3dykrnzTjJ6pbEwaxhGEXUi7QFd7mswQLgy4eMchi8cTxKYPQQwRpD0Fsu11iY7fOFpf1XZUsNRiIpn8YIoFzjk143qLXJRgGG2NWdcWJFDEy2SxaFXyyRBHZfEt0L8CIGQbsOOL94kPrWNybu6h9eDQpzPJVFqMj8COPNMXINDNJZQ_wJmE2E2a1FnZGAr7-G9UlBXJa_z5Hu25L_ALRYxU_WxKoZZYEkz4KfbMVEnmZgm3ybq6uZjLduCS-GLQQfmSP3JkatVR191jVNexYcpU8wXD8eI1NOnnCclzkT1_QTD4sPOClnJLdmoxc07q_cBbybzRE)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6350bf8e44084876bffd587aa805f298&_e=xYvMFZHZCsolqawEFpcxorSSeyABMqY7eyNJaPk9sqQb8TvHJIWoewB3dykrnzTjJ6pbEwaxhGEXUi7QFd7mswQLgy4eMchi8cTxKYPQQwRpD0Fsu11iY7fOFpf1XZUsNRiIpn8YIoFzjk143qLXJRgGG2NWdcWJFDEy2SxaFXyyRBHZfEt0L8CIGQbsOOL94kPrWNybu6h9eDQpzPJVFqMj8COPNMXINDNJZQ_wJmHii3as9SNHU8d5WPA3kVuujXzhLu7XQQQSWpA6nvhTCwKuZCnAMRneLjA-A8H-Fs1hDRvzRJ1SuNSU9zEJOVTiUNDfBVMQ2ABZw-Das8vx7ystjtg6y3bKn8kPKsS7pQfKSE2O7soNQkVMB5c8BGly)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

name: Hillsdale College via Trump News HQ
subject: Take our Critical Race Theory Survey
body:
I’m reaching out because you’re an informed patriot who cares about this country.

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvoid6uhohf9dejc0rb2u52grgscsik7b5q5cd20_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s9i69pr0clh2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ztj6cldjqge8m792mf3p45q1btmbh0dk1ubjes90_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s9i69pr0clh2bs)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3do1ke3qagmn6ijnng2lc222ivnovap75ac79q8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s9i69pr0clh2bs)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Your participation and support are essential in our fight against CRT. Please complete the survey and consider a generous gift to help us continue our educational mission at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zg4gkpflkmijasghspt99nped8q5hstho4a9kgk8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj0s9i69pr0clh2bs)

body:
I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country.

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=fbd46985a8d0451f9c67df769253adc0&_e=2_aSbtug3OWFwC5J9ZB8NHLSTJG4Nav4lCWMC4dgTyFk36mvDST3j-KFdZ9HFn3253lxI4GQF5hrYxhNOe06n4PMt8WYfsQMhpnTS0_fh87iLjdd50gQoWDSr0TA-LLZT7AKEPCI4a3p0HIR80TQeFO46-mzV064tb5-UWPgG-WXdy4xS1xrg2G8Fu-tgB6BDVTRGMH5wbeealELhSkYTqBmjO-aapeLbF367VRvbKKSlxyXz9v4XWBfbwcITZeH_BpH4vmwTPZJuXeU1qFp4layJLfBEQywp0em5PMJsFexj5a0aflMLyFPygXjRBA_yeDagkb0HBH65A1bY0WF4RmHbqio9B5NSVW3xzrDcfzje83BhHVpdEvZyWNupExm)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

[**Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT).**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=fbd46985a8d0451f9c67df769253adc0&_e=2_aSbtug3OWFwC5J9ZB8NHLSTJG4Nav4lCWMC4dgTyFk36mvDST3j-KFdZ9HFn3253lxI4GQF5hrYxhNOe06n4PMt8WYfsQMhpnTS0_fh87iLjdd50gQoWDSr0TA-LLZT7AKEPCI4a3p0HIR80TQeFO46-mzV064tb5-UWPgG-WXdy4xS1xrg2G8Fu-tgB6BDVTRGMH5wbeealELhSkYTqBmjO-aapeLbF367VRvbKL6TAB8ZCjM0TY24wiH2SbgHDRn-1rI02LQotBujCgIqo4elmpO0Z6mRpflvGDUeajnzEax508iusoBKrjUltPj7QeqEYwYVKJsSzgLSgAeCYxSUlu-xXVvsUfPl9V4gP6xesyrab1QWr8kQte6v0QY)

I'm reaching out because you're an informed patriot who cares about this country. The situation is urgent, and your response will only take a few moments.

CRT has been around for decades.

Feminist academics used to make arguments about "unpacking their invisible knapsacks of privilege." However, at the time, CRT was rejected for being "just _another_ crazy fringe academic theory."

**Today, the situation is much different ...and much worse.**

_Now_ , CRT infiltrates our schools and workplaces. It's not so laughable for you to have to sit in a meeting or seminar that explains to you your "invisible knapsack of privilege."

To speak up often means you can lose your job, or worse...

What's frightening for the direction of this country is that federal agencies have labeled some parents who oppose CRT as "domestic terrorists."

**This should NOT be happening in America.**

Hillsdale College--where I work--teaches the principles of liberty and justice that our country was founded on. And we're fighting to defend them on the battlefield of education.

**But we need YOUR help to defend our constitutional principles against CRT.** Sharing your opinion with us is one important way you can take action.

**Complete your National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory now:[https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=fbd46985a8d0451f9c67df769253adc0&_e=2_aSbtug3OWFwC5J9ZB8NHLSTJG4Nav4lCWMC4dgTyFk36mvDST3j-KFdZ9HFn3253lxI4GQF5hrYxhNOe06n4PMt8WYfsQMhpnTS0_fh87iLjdd50gQoWDSr0TA-LLZT7AKEPCI4a3p0HIR80TQeFO46-mzV064tb5-UWPgG-WXdy4xS1xrg2G8Fu-tgB6BDVTRGMH5wbeealELhSkYTqBmjO-aapeLbF367VRvbKL15r1D0xh6H3BRCMOa-JH_Xf6f0bSXOYXHP0rbyipDSrneZ1b5HdzeuaoE6OFp5KbMtrPDlxkb4N2W5Scv6om1SRNbWvTZ2gt4UAqN7-T2L0HhEeRWnI9PlIJsAtDISMpqb5U_29_YKjdtOdan1qi7)**

When you participate in our survey, you will help us gather the information needed to address CRT's threats to our liberty and find solutions that restore our constitutional principles.

When you finish taking your survey, please consider giving a generous gift.

Our NATIONAL EDUCATION CAMPAIGN--which includes _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and K-12 curriculum and school network--educates millions of citizens about our Constitution and founding principles.

We need your help expanding these initiatives. And because we do not take a single penny of taxpayer funding, even indirectly through federal and state student grants loans--all of our work is funded by informed patriots like you.

Thank you for joining us in our mission on behalf of liberty.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

P.S. Your participation and support are essential in our fight against CRT. Please complete the survey and consider a generous gift to help us continue our educational mission at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=fbd46985a8d0451f9c67df769253adc0&_e=2_aSbtug3OWFwC5J9ZB8NHLSTJG4Nav4lCWMC4dgTyFk36mvDST3j-KFdZ9HFn3253lxI4GQF5hrYxhNOe06n4PMt8WYfsQMhpnTS0_fh87iLjdd50gQoWDSr0TA-LLZT7AKEPCI4a3p0HIR80TQeFO46-mzV064tb5-UWPgG-WXdy4xS1xrg2G8Fu-tgB6BDVTRGMH5wbeealELhSkYTqBmjO-aapeLbF367VRvbKLV6TwRD-vkf0t0cyk1rDfsZ3ZkJyHm_IO_l8-6FRRlr470oKe3Kd3qGukBrog3R3tm81OfUp4BKXTraDph8dl1om2BXmwGrF5pBDLg3hwefQc6m9LGeqcJB7FSP_lw-Cae6vFeLhDpzFENZ35RsEO_)

Friend,

You probably didn’t wake up this morning and think, “ _Today's the day I’m going to make a $10 donation to DMP's campaign!_ ” — **but ahead of my first end-of-week deadline of October, it's what I’m about to ask you to do.**
Unlike Rick Scott, I don't have a massive fortune at my campaign's disposal. I come from a working-class family, so I know my eye-watering **$3 million end-of-week goal** is nothing to shake a stick at. But it's the only way I'll be able to defeat him.
**_[If that's all you need to hear, please click here to chip in $10 now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94393311/503370012/1820369458?amounts=10, 25,50,100,250&amount=10&refcode=jtk2147-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDI0NzI0ZDMtY2I4My1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ZJfbAVNnQzxHfm5iW_U91g96s9BGwEaUdSnsjo_hbrs=)_ **— **but I'd like to share what your hard-earned $10 means to me.**
See, my family moved to the US from Ecuador with big dreams for a better life when I was 14. But it didn't come easy, and despite my mom working back-to-back double shifts, we still struggled to afford rent on our one room apartment.
**So once I turned 15, I began taking early morning shifts at a doughnut shop before school.** It wasn't much, but the extra cash gave my family room to breathe, and eventually, the life we dreamt of finally came true.
But I'm not the only one who got their start in the doughnut business. When he was a young man, my opponent, Rick Scott, _**bought**_ two doughnut shops.
While I made minimum wage to help keep the lights on at home, he reaped the benefits of his employees' hard work.
**For me, those $10 boxes of doughnuts were a lifeline that helped my family get by. For him, they kicked off a career in penthouse C-suites.**
**_[And with your $10, you can help me kick Rick out of the Senate on election night — so please, pitch in now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94393312/503370013/1820369458?amounts=10, 25,50,100,250&amount=10&refcode=jtk2147-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDI0NzI0ZDMtY2I4My1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ZJfbAVNnQzxHfm5iW_U91g96s9BGwEaUdSnsjo_hbrs=)_ **
| | [CONTRIBUTE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94393313/503370014/1820369458?amounts=10, 25,50,100,250&amount=10&refcode=jtk2147-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZDI0NzI0ZDMtY2I4My1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ZJfbAVNnQzxHfm5iW_U91g96s9BGwEaUdSnsjo_hbrs=)

I went on to graduate college, fight to improve life for working families like my own, and become the first South American immigrant elected to Congress. Rick Scott went on to enrich himself off U.S. taxpayers via the largest Medicare fraud scheme in history, amass a nine-figure fortune, and buy his way into the Senate.
**So I don't take your help toward reaching my $3 million end-of-week goal tonight lightly.** There's simply no way I could ever do it on my own.
My opponent, however, can spend $3 million to get his ads on screens without thinking twice — _and he has already spent plenty more to stop me._
**_So th[e only way we'll get him out and give working Floridians the Senate representation we deserve is if we hit my $3 million goal by midnight tonight. body:
Chip in to this grassroots movement for fair elections
|

Can you feel it, Peter? The momentum is building to end extreme partisan gerrymandering — for good.
Together, we have made huge strides in the fight against electoral map manipulation — winning in the courts, securing fairer maps, and safeguarding the principle that every vote counts. We are making steady progress, but this fight won’t be won overnight— finishing the job takes time and organizing.
**Election Day will be a crucial moment for this movement — but we can’t forget that it will be followed by many _more crucial_ moments:** future court cases, redistricting battles, state legislature races, and many others. The energy we harness during this election season is a building block for our efforts next year — and the year after that, and the year after that.
Peter, as a supporter of All On The Line, you understand the importance of state-level organizing in the fight for fairer maps. This work may not get the most headlines or attention in the media — but that’s precisely why these state-by-state efforts are so essential.
**Fair maps are the key to making meaningful, lasting progress on the issues that matter most.** Whether you care about affordable health care, equal pay, gun violence, reproductive rights, voting rights, or climate change — gerrymandering is a fundamental structural barrier that prevents us from addressing these persistent challenges in a way that represents the true will of the people.
Together, we will keep racking up the wins for fairer maps in state after state so we can end this cycle of dysfunction and extreme partisanship.
**We cannot let our democracy be undone in the shadows — it’s up to each of us to do our part to fight for its survival.[If you’re all-in to fight for fairer maps this November and beyond, chip in](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94401340/503375012/1627685812?refcode=don_aotl_redite_email_Momentum_email_20241006-AOTL-RedLite-Momentum_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241006-AOTL-RedLite-Momentum_&utm_campaign=Momentum&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY3ZTZlNTdkLWRhODMtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=n9XzlyEqobPKHfM5bfYFnO9EqdhaEuMyWR6qzz-u4v4=)**[** right now and we’ll put it right to work to power our comprehensive state-level efforts to end gerrymandering and defend our democracy.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94401341/503375013/1627685812?refcode=don_aotl_redite_email_Momentum_email_20241006-AOTL-RedLite-Momentum_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20241006-AOTL-RedLite-Momentum_&utm_campaign=Momentum&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY3ZTZlNTdkLWRhODMtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=n9XzlyEqobPKHfM5bfYFnO9EqdhaEuMyWR6qzz-u4v4=)

clean_body: Chip in to this grassroots movement for fair elections | Can you feel it, Peter? The momentum is building to end extreme partisan gerrymandering — for good. Together, we have made huge strides in the fight against electoral map manipulation — winning in the courts, securing fairer maps, and safeguarding the principle that every vote counts. We are making steady progress, but this fight won’t be won overnight— finishing the job takes time and organizing. Election Day will be a crucial moment for this movement — but we can’t forget that it will be followed by many more crucial moments: future court cases, redistricting battles, state legislature races, and many others. The energy we harness during this election season is a building block for our efforts next year — and the year after that, and the year after that. Peter, as a supporter of All On The Line, you understand the importance of state-level organizing in the fight for fairer maps. This work may not get the most headlines or attention in the media — but that’s precisely why these state-by-state efforts are so essential. Fair maps are the key to making meaningful, lasting progress on the issues that matter most. Whether you care about affordable health care, equal pay, gun violence, reproductive rights, voting rights, or climate change — gerrymandering is a fundamental structural barrier that prevents us from addressing these persistent challenges in a way that represents the true will of the people. Together, we will keep racking up the wins for fairer maps in state after state so we can end this cycle of dysfunction and extreme partisanship. ---
Peter, There's been a lot of talk about me, my campaign, and why I decided to run for U.S. Senate, so I wanted to set the record straight as to why I am doing all of this. I apologize in advance for the length of this email and if you only read the first half of this email, let me sum up my why: **I am running for the U.S. Senate because I love this country and I fought for it for 25 years in war zones all around the world. But the values I fought for are at risk, and I'll NEVER give up on the greatest nation on Earth.** If you know me, by now you have probably heard me tell the same story: America saved my life. When I was just four years old my parents barely escaped Vietnam just hours before the fall of Saigon to a communist regime. By the grace of God, we made it out alive and found a new home in America. And from day one, I was taught not to take our newfound freedoms for granted. I graduated from the US Naval Academy, and became a Special Operations officer, a deep sea diver, and an Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) technician. During more than two decades in the US Navy, I served with US and allied Special Operations units in Iraq, Afghanistan and Somalia, and other hazardous duty locations - these were certainly not “pleasant tourist destinations.” Serving our country was the honor of a lifetime. Now, I’m running for U.S. Senate because I know my service isn’t over yet. For nearly three decades I abided by an oath to “support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic.” But now, we have politicians who are giving up America on a silver platter. Tim Kaine has been putting our Commonwealth and our country LAST for too long, and it’s time for a new generation of leadership. I believe in freedom above all because I’ve seen firsthand what happens when you lose it. Now, the political elite are on a mission to silence me because I’m about to become the biggest thorn in Tim Kaine’s side. [**This will be my most difficult mission yet, and I****’****m counting on YOU to join my A-team. Please, if you****’****re sick and tired of the same career politicians, will you join our fight today?**](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=17242c6534f640d18ed0740ae7d4eca8&_e=C4X33mlvaqgy13nIVDX4zbU__zVc53nSpjVxMXggujrvd0c3OdNMn6wYizCU_2ftIeOusXlyxD-erOscFoMByeCSY8aThUdETcBK4V6Zj9CV_A1umxv0zRcOqig9UvYmRwCNANBjjy96eKPWWoGOWS015ZlgPFYl9H-9qFWiNrKJl7ChmzDc9oE3tRFklQpG5NPYNdNkp5jQmJHI4xQ3ly2ollnStBuIrQfFgu2_iNEdG55kbw6BnFCE3uZU3Rm1anrleYwwSGEGHghqxFnSF4HqaPfe2rbvnvnPdRwyd1FeZZb5-ehrrdJZNR5sqdkYvG5LGGe23dnX_S7Aij4bDgQhoPFu9dIOFG56nIBok51TPwYnnh9jYvGPchiskl0ctZNE4OUHovOv4Z60gchw_w%3D%3D)****

subject: Reserve Your “Western Heritage” DVD Set
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsJjW03W2N

I invite you to study the history of the "big questions" with
my colleagues and me.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osJjW03W2N

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear
Friend,

Every
Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the
Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year,
I'm reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to questions
like "Does God exist? Can we know God?" with my students.

These
questions are at the core of what it means to be human - both in
our relationship with each other and with God.

Today, I
want to offer you that same experience by sending you a
limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course,
"Western Heritage - From the Book of Genesis to John Locke," as a
token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of
Hillsdale's efforts to educate America.

I invite
you to study the history of the "big questions" with my
colleagues and me.

Reserve
your DVD set now using this secure link:
https://secure.hillsdale.edu/support-western-heritage-dvd

More than
2,000 people have already requested theirs, so make sure to get
your set before they are all gone.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

subject: We Skip Endorsements – Why You Should Too
body:
News + editorial to start your week | Broad + Liberty Weekly Reads | | | |
---
| | | Good morning and welcome to _Broad + Liberty_ 's Weekly Reads.

[Subscribe to our daily email list](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=34de60eb58&e=b7b3eddce2) and get the best of _Broad + Liberty_ delivered straight to your inbox.

### **1.[Kilkenny versus Upper Darby](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=9be9c07ef1&e=b7b3eddce2)**
_By Bradley Vasoli_
"What you’re not going to do is silence us,” Olivia Taylor warned the Upper Darby officials perched two dozen feet in front of her. “We got at least ten of us right here to take your sorry asses to court! See you there!” The east end township resident chastised councilpersons who would soon vote, with Democratic Mayor Ed Brown’s support, to limit public comment during legislative hearings. With the new restrictions in place, councilpersons would then proceed to impose a new one-percent earned income tax (EIT). Over a dozen of Taylor’s fellow citizens rose during the September 4 meeting’s early forum period to echo her outrage. Across from the Council chamber’s center podium where they stood sat Brown and most of the eleven-member Council. Also at the dais was a man who never ran for election in Upper Darby but still regularly occupies the very middle seat, as if to suggest his peculiar sway over the Philadelphia border town: Solicitor Sean Kilkenny. **Why It Matters. **The lawsuit Taylor predicted is getting filed Monday by Drexel Hill resident John DeMasi and six other plaintiffs who complain the township violated state and federal law as well as the municipality’s Home Rule Charter (HRC) when adopting the new speech restrictions and the EIT. The case is only the latest in a series of collisions between Kilkenny and the governing document the township hired him to defend. DeMasi and his co-plaintiffs point out not only that the HRC states everyone must be heard but that the federal and state constitutions say the same.[ The Pennsylvania Constitution](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=9a36f47ad3&e=b7b3eddce2) guarantees citizens the “right... to apply to those invested with the powers of government for redress of grievances or other proper purposes, by petition, address or remonstrance.” The U.S. Constitution’s[ First Amendment](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=8f504ca3c5&e=b7b3eddce2) also protects that right. **Quotable.** “This is B.S.,” Chris Fabre said. “You’re stifling free speech.” The Beverly Hills resident and grandfather returned to his seat, but not before[ quoting](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=6aff9d2255&e=b7b3eddce2) children’s author Laurie Halse Anderson thus: “Censorship is the child of fear, the father of ignorance and the desperate weapon of fascists everywhere.” **[Continue reading part one](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2b24e0d6ca&e=b7b3eddce2) **and**[part two](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=1688e37737&e=b7b3eddce2) **of this important story.
---
|
---
|
### **2.[From the Editors: We don’t endorse candidates, and neither should any media outlet.](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=025d0b9ce6&e=b7b3eddce2)**

_From the Editors_
Political endorsements have always been at odds with the supposed objectivity of media organizations.
Although most newspapers proclaim a strict separation between news decisions and editorial judgements — and many people in those organizations try their best to uphold that wall of separation — it beggars belief to say that there is no connection between the opinions of the editors on one page and the way news is presented on the next. Left-wing newspapers endorse Democrats, right-wing papers endorse Republicans. When that means backing an unqualified candidate, it diminishes the credibility of the entire organization.

**Why It Matters**. By endorsing candidates — and especially by routinely endorsing candidates of the same party — editorial boards diminish their organizations’ appearance of neutrality and impartiality. It’s a disservice to the reader as well as to those reporters who are trying to do their jobs the right way.

_Broad + Liberty_ is, like the _Inquirer_ ’s owners, a non-profit organization. As such, we do not endorse candidates for any office. But even if we were not prevented from doing so by the tax laws, we would still not endorse. Why? Because the public has lost enough trust in the media already. We publish opinion pieces, as the _Inquirer_ and others do, but we also seek to report the news without bias. For impartiality to be believed, it must be seen. Endorsements show people the opposite.

[Continue Reading](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e2e41ee78f&e=b7b3eddce2)

By Bradley Vasoli "What you’re not going to do is silence us,” Olivia Taylor warned the Upper Darby officials perched two dozen feet in front of her. “We got at least ten of us right here to take your sorry asses to court! See you there!” The east end township resident chastised councilpersons who would soon vote, with Democratic Mayor Ed Brown’s support, to limit public comment during legislative hearings. With the new restrictions in place, councilpersons would then proceed to impose a new one-percent earned income tax (EIT). Over a dozen of Taylor’s fellow citizens rose during the September 4 meeting’s early forum period to echo her outrage. Across from the Council chamber’s center podium where they stood sat Brown and most of the eleven-member Council. Also at the dais was a man who never ran for election in Upper Darby but still regularly occupies the very middle seat, as if to suggest his peculiar sway over the Philadelphia border town: Solicitor Sean Kilkenny. Why It Matters. The lawsuit Taylor predicted is getting filed Monday by Drexel Hill resident John DeMasi and six other plaintiffs who complain the township violated state and federal law as well as the municipality’s Home Rule Charter (HRC) when adopting the new speech restrictions and the EIT. The case is only the latest in a series of collisions between Kilkenny and the governing document the township hired him to defend. DeMasi and his co-plaintiffs point out not only that the HRC states everyone must be heard but that the federal and state constitutions say the same. guarantees citizens the “right... to apply to those invested with the powers of government for redress of grievances or other proper purposes, by petition, address or remonstrance.” The U.S. Constitution’s also protects that right. Quotable. “This is B.S.,” Chris Fabre said. “You’re stifling free speech.” The Beverly Hills resident and grandfather returned to his seat, but not before children’s author Laurie Halse Anderson thus: “Censorship is the child of fear, the father of ignorance and the desperate weapon of fascists everywhere.” and of this important story. | | 2. From the Editors Political endorsements have always been at odds with the supposed objectivity of media organizations. Although most newspapers proclaim a strict separation between news decisions and editorial judgements — and many people in those organizations try their best to uphold that wall of separation — it beggars belief to say that there is no connection between the opinions of the editors on one page and the way news is presented on the next. Left-wing newspapers endorse Democrats, right-wing papers endorse Republicans. When that means backing an unqualified candidate, it diminishes the credibility of the entire organization. Why It Matters. By endorsing candidates — and especially by routinely endorsing candidates of the same party — editorial boards diminish their organizations’ appearance of neutrality and impartiality. It’s a disservice to the reader as well as to those reporters who are trying to do their jobs the right way. Broad + Liberty is, like the Inquirer ’s owners, a non-profit organization. As such, we do not endorse candidates for any office. But even if we were not prevented from doing so by the tax laws, we would still not endorse. Why? Because the public has lost enough trust in the media already. We publish opinion pieces, as the Inquirer and others do, but we also seek to report the news without bias. Ballots drop in Arizona on Wednesday. Early voting begins on Wednesday. And Ruben debates Kari Lake on Wednesday.
This is a huge day.

Fellow American,

In case you missed it, here's the bottom line up front.

✔ I joined Mark Levin on _Life, Liberty & Levin_ recently to discuss the state of the race in Pennsylvania, the #1 swing state in the nation.

**✔ Pennsylvania is Mark Levin 's home state. As he said, he takes this race _very personally and wants to win this Senate seat._**

Mark and I discussed a number of issues, from the situation in the Middle East, to the crisis at the border, and the urgent need to defeat Kamala Harris and Bob Casey, who have shown complete weakness on every issue that is impacting us.

**It 's not hyperbole to say this is the most consequential election of our lives.** All eyes are on Pennsylvania as the top swing state and I'm running in the #1 battleground race that _WILL decide the Senate majority and control of the White House._

As a combat veteran, I've been on tough missions. But if I'm going to win my next mission to defeat a Democrat who's spent 18 years in DC & flip the Senate to GOP control, I'm going to need your support.

**The fight isn’t over, and I’m counting on you to help push us across the finish line.[Can you rush a contribution of $10, $25, or whatever you can right now to help us finish strong?](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=07275abe2a604217b158e1948a067f6e&_e=mSKOMVLjM6uylPB48SLB2jQIM7d3JR0djCzFgO1sKfQdyrRU6K-NIpxAFhqWp7EDVeCYs67fy0Mq5WagaJW9BB_DtmxeQZsD4_PifZkDIRZnHt2kzsR_4Y4jYUxtO6p9QyUjOVR8JNRTbnAhT8Mv9WczIhU9TAdtuIVtCF0W2aGeUOmw6aT7u4bfWYOtXt0D3OceMpWp9b0x9WLCCX-xZo_-XvEyLlVZ6rUcqj-02doNXg5yCWv8D7uqCu1eRQLww0eR7LHXMw6RlOxjZAqFcgqWy1vYBZ1hJglw6uqOwn2s27bqACW5SIjWpWH3mGlyVSmAO0ao5G1ayul6YGGXaSdVUEqrGd5-yajBKRcr4Rr0LUUy-2sZm4K00whuiUgQqwZOBSVBhcsai5TLSi46Xw%3D%3D)**

**_The time to pitch in to help us win this race is NOW.

Voters are making their final decisions. Ballots have been mailed to Pennsylvanians in a number of counties and voters are voting early in person._**

It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this _**[could make a donation of any amount](http://links.conservativesfordjt.com/u/click?_t=05b03ef2209247bcbdad7fd5099cd670&_m=07275abe2a604217b158e1948a067f6e&_e=mSKOMVLjM6uylPB48SLB2jQIM7d3JR0djCzFgO1sKfQdyrRU6K-NIpxAFhqWp7EDVeCYs67fy0Mq5WagaJW9BB_DtmxeQZsD4_PifZkDIRZnHt2kzsR_4Y4jYUxtO6p9QyUjOVR8JNRTbnAhT8Mv9WczIhU9TAdtuIVtCF0W2aGeUOmw6aT7u4bfWYOtXt0D3OceMpWp9b0x9WLCCX-xZo_-XvEyLlVZ6rUcqj-02dopOnES1Fohw93IExeJHRBzTIyL5MqAJh6m6vweJ8gLGnKeZ_EQzL7uCOCgahz8K6z85CwOi8Pf56XSdl0DblpBeIdPePAAAWEp75aGPVhkmr66X_lXwo9uN-0Fj6uvdhyiauRuZtNIvETOCpgg82XHAjLXBnhXx7r2kL7Ux0ZJRw%3D%3D)**_ to show the strength of our movement during this critical fight for Pennsylvania and our great nation's future.

_Dave McCormick_

This week the odometer hit 42,000 miles since I started the campaign in February. What a whirlwind couple of weeks! My team and I made it to the DC/DOX film festival for the screening of the MSNBC film, "From Russia with Lev", where we met up with Lev Parnas and Jamie Raskin. From DC we went to NYC for "An Evening with Lev Parnas", which was covered by Politico. A few other news outlets, distracted by other news events unfolding in New York City at that same hour, are preparing longer profiles on the movie and our race.
Our North Country journalist, Alex Gault travelled to cover the story, which netted the most number of clicks ever for the [Watertown Daily times online edition](https://substack.com/redirect/4eaa75ba-a698-465c-a483-f6fa20e834db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and resulted in the paper picking up a few new subscribers. In case you missed it, we had a mobile truck circling the vicinity of Trump Tower during our event, playing the trailer of Lev's film with an ad for my campaign (you can see it in the photo gallery).
Additionally we have made it to many great North Country events and met some interesting voters. We meet Democrats who are supportive and encouraging. We meet voters who are MAGA supporters. We also meet undecided voters. NY Prop 1 gives us a great starting point for a conversation with a voter. Many people have not heard of it. As I speak with voters about it, I can easily pivot to a discussion about my candidacy, and the need to support the full slate of Democrats on the ballot in each voting district.
In the photo gallery, you will find photos from a meet and greet in Little Falls (Herkimer County), a presidential debate watch party in Saranac Lake (Franklin and Essex Counties), a Q&A in [Malone (Franklin County)](https://substack.com/redirect/bb03ff5b-9e3e-405f-b82f-38c9e92efa3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a dinner party in Canton (St. Lawrence County), "Desserts and Democracy" in Moreau (Saratoga County), and a working session with volunteers in Plattsburgh (Clinton County). I have had press sit downs with a number of news outlets, including [CBS6 in the Albany area](https://substack.com/redirect/eb23b55b-a535-4286-af19-8510b86a77f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). I've recorded a few more segments that should play in upcoming days and weeks. In case you missed it, [here was a spot that aired](https://substack.com/redirect/ca5c3fbe-9a11-4428-8f99-ae548c582a8a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) three weeks ago in Plattsburgh. In a more recent clip, Stefanik was asked by WAMC why she won't debate. [Here it is](https://substack.com/redirect/f4f00b10-2d94-4756-a7b9-4e74c8d4c92b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the news.
What's next? We are canvassing and phonebanking. One team member is traveling to New York City soon to work with phonebanking volunteers there. Meanwhile, here we are getting our last batch of signs out, making other signs, and going door-to-door. We have a few very early morning breakfasts in the Mohawk Valley (thank goodness for Stewart's). We have a few evening events coming up, and still more that we are trying to confirm. The calendar is still a work in progress.
On Sunday, October 13, 2024, we are screening "From Russia with Lev" at the St. Lawrence County Democratic Headquarters at 57 Martket Street in Potsdam. This is a combined effort, meant to also be a ribbon-cutting for the headquarters. The headquarters in St. Lawrence has been a godsend. Volunteers are there from open to close, giving out signs, answering questions, and creating materials for other volunteers to go door-to-door. Thank you, Mike Zagrobelny, Chair of St. Lawrence County Democrats and Mayor of Waddington! In an ideal world -- in a world in which we focus on winning rural counties -- we will have a headquarters in every county in the North Country. (Shown in the photo gallery are pics of the St. Lawrence County Democratic headquarters, funded by the county committee, and the Oneida Democratic headquarters in Utica, funded by the state party as part of the state's coordinated campaign.) These, and the Adirondacks Voters for Change office on Broadway in Saranac Lake, make the process of getting signs, postcards, canvassers, and phonebanking activities centralized and focused.
At a minimum, we are building relationships and momentum that will kick off the race for the midterms on November 6, 2024. New York 21 is vast, with 15 counties sprawling over 15,000 square miles. It takes a while to build infrastructure and processes in the campaign. Donations large and small help. But contrary to popular belief, the greatest challenge is not financial; it's building the support, volunteers, and a responsive team on the ground.
And in that sense, we are already winning. Even if we don't turn NY-21 blue this time, we can darn sure turn it pink and possibly a deep purple. We are just getting started in this effort to win the North Country for Democrats.
Ballots are out. We are in a position of strength on the ballot, with Harris/Walz first, followed by Gillibrand, followed by me, all on Line A. I'm also on Line D for the Working Families Party line.
In the last NY-21 race, 285,095 people turned out to vote, for a 36% voter turnout. Of those, Stefanik got 168,579, while Castelli got 116,421. This year, a major population center, Rome, is in the district. That, plus the boost in enthusiasm for the Harris run, has me hopeful that we might just see a change in the result this year.
It is possible that we could ride the electric blue wave that is sweeping the country, and have a victory on November 5.
A congressional race is not like a race that requires an Electoral College vote. We don't have to win all 15 counties; we need to get a majority of the votes, drawn from villages, towns, and cities throughout the district. If, by some stroke, we gained a majority of the votes from ballots cast in 4-5 counties, with a sprinkling of the votes from the other 9-10 counties, we would win. Every vote counts towards a win in this race.
Meanwhile, Stefanik continues in her blind allegiance to Donald Trump. The filing in Judge Chutkan's court by Jack Smith caused me to post a letter stating unequivocally that Stefanik is not fit to be in Congress. [I have called for her immediate resignation and suspension of her bid for re-election. ](https://substack.com/redirect/7dc800ad-1f03-4969-9a72-e6bcb37e7b69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Elise Stefanik proudly boasts that she speaks frequently with Donald Trump. It is, therefore, unfathomable that she did not know of the existence or the extent of the crimes that were being committed. As a sitting member of Congress, she had an ethical obligation to disclose those lies and irregularities. Imagine how differently things would have been in our state and in our country had Elise Stefanik taken the approach of Liz Cheney, and worked to bring the truth to the American people about the atrocities of Donald Trump.
Stefanik has never disavowed herself of the claim that Donald Trump won the 2020 election. Stefanik supports the January 6 insurrectionists, calling them "hostages". She has never come out against those who worked to hang then-vice-president Mike Pence. Stefanik is a good a faithful foot soldier to Donald Trump.
I've learned from my conversations with Lev Parnas that being in Trump World is a lot like being swept up in an addiction. All perspective is lost. Lev talks about realizing that the only thing that mattered was protecting Donald Trump -- no matter the cost or the ethics.
It is possible that we will have some constituents cast their ballots for Kamala Harris, but then think they should continue to vote for Stefanik. There is a perception in the North Country that she is untainted by Trump's criminal network. Please discourage this.
Stefanik will only protect our North Country if and when it suits Trump.
If re-elected, Stefanik will continue to be disruptive, obstructive, and divisive. She, along with other relatively young MAGA supporters such as Josh Hawley, JD Vance, Mike Johnson, Marjorie Taylor Greene, and others should be nowhere near the halls of our government buildings. Their agenda is fatal to the life and essence of our democracy.
Please help me in the following ways: 1) [Send donations to ActBlue](https://substack.com/redirect/a91b76e2-abb2-4cc0-80c5-8da53b6c53bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or send a check to Paula Collins for Congress; 441 Old State Road; Dekalb Junction, NY 13630. We need to put gas in the car. We need to pay our one part-time staffer and cover the food and housing expenses of the full time staffer. 2) Embrace the joy and enthusiasm that we see at the top of the ticket while simultaneously resisting the urge to perpetuate cynicism. Democrats love to analyze. Sometimes we just need to set the odds aside and lean in to the dream. We are all on the same team -- we want Democrats elected. It does our campaign no good to perpetuate the myth that the candidate with the most money will necessarily be the candidate who prevails. 3) In that spirit, tell 5 people who tell another 5 people, who tell another 5 people: Elise Stefanik has an opponent. 4) Write letters to the editor. These have proven to be very effective in the North Country. 5) Reach out if you are available for phonebanking. We need the help!
We win by getting more than half of the votes. We win by turning NY-21 pink or purple. We win by building the network of volunteers and the processes to launch the midterm campaign on November 6, 2024.
We are already winning.
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _

clean_body: I have to be honest: We have a real problem. | Peter, Trisha Calvarese here, the Democratic nominee running against Lauren Boebert. My team and I are working hard to flip Colorado’s 4th congressional district blue so that Democrats can take back the House, finally put an end to Lauren Boebert’s ridiculous political career, and stop Boebert from receiving a lifetime congressional pension. But I have to be honest: With less than 30 days left until Election Day, we have a real problem. Right now, we’re falling behind on our fundraising goals, and my team tells me that unless we raise another $50,000 before midnight tonight, we’re going to have to cut our budget – and risk losing to Lauren Boebert... Boebert won by only 546 votes in 2022. We cannot afford to give up any ground. That’s why I am launching an Emergency Midnight Fundraising Goal of raising another $50,000 to get us back on track to beating Boebert and flipping this seat blue. subject: Jamie Raskin just BROKE his silence >>

body:
Now he needs our total support.
| **REMEMBER:** Donald Trump wouldn’t have become President in 2016 without the Electoral College, _and it could happen AGAIN if we don’t fight back NOW._

That’s why Democratic heroes like Rep. Jamie Raskin are taking ACTION, and we’re THRILLED: [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81359?t=6&akid=17328%2E878179%2E2FfFFM) But folks, Rep. Raskin’s BRAVERY has put a target on his back, and MAGA Republicans are FURIOUS. [**We need an immediate SURGE of Democrats to stand with Jamie Raskin today. Add your name! »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81359?t=7&akid=17328%2E878179%2E2FfFFM) | TO: Rep. Jamie Raskin
FROM: Your Strongest Supporter
Subject: Thank you. Dear Rep. Jamie Raskin,

**I couldn’t be more grateful to have your voice in the House at this critical time in our history.**

We know Trump could win the Presidency via the Electoral College again this year unless we take immediate action — _so we stand with you wholeheartedly in your fight._

Republicans know they can’t ever win the White House again without the Electoral College — we know they’re TERRIFIED of your momentum!

But you’ve stood up to Donald Trump and his MAGA Republicans over and over again, _so we’re grateful you’re not backing down now and totally we have your back!_

[**I can’t thank you enough for protecting our democracy from Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans – so I’m signing this letter and chipping in $3 to keep electing Democrats like you who will fight tirelessly to abolish the Electoral College! »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81359?t=8&akid=17328%2E878179%2E2FfFFM) | [ADD YOUR NAME: SIGN OUR LETTER TO THANK REP. it couldn’t be more critical that we make sure we’re helping every single voter register and get to the polls.
|
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94420055/503428190/1541756421?refcode=ODP_ATA_EM_FR_Voterreg_241006_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZmMyNDBlOC1lZTgzLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XOeck__aoIlvT1TO_n0p4BCZHv53m159XUufAyNTjQY=) Tomorrow is a big day, team. **Ohio’s voter registration deadline.**

body:
It’s important.

| Hey there, folks, Willie Nelson and Margo Price here. We recently teamed up to talk about something mighty important — November’s right around the corner, and what we do with our votes could make a big difference, especially down in Tennessee and Texas. We know we’re all talking about the presidential race right now, and that’s important. But we want to shine a light on two other races that hit closer to home. **This November, we’ve got a real shot to elect Gloria Johnson and Colin Allred to the U.S. Senate.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94420870/503430829/-1457683982?refcode=ea.a225aa28-f083-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ms=ea.a225aa28-f083-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMjI1YWEyOC1mMDgzLWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GE5cV8M9YyZFxfzqIsrFtzgduyOnadyn961zu0x8Cgk=) There are 33 Senate seats up for grabs in November. One of them could go to Gloria — a leader who isn’t afraid to fight for _all_ Tennesseans, no matter their race, who they worship, or who they love. She’s got the grit to take on the big fights, whether it’s protecting LGBTQ+ rights or looking out for working families. Tennessee needs someone like her — someone who’s in tune with what real people are going through. Another one of those seats could go to Colin Allred — he’s a 4th generation Texan who was raised by a single mom in Dallas. After playing in the NFL and serving as a civil rights attorney, Colin was elected to the House of Representatives, where he fights to protect the fundamental values of our democracy. Texas has had too many years of Ted Cruz just looking out for himself — it’s time to get someone in the Senate who will look out for all Texans, and that’s Colin. But here’s the deal, friend: None of this happens if folks don’t vote. Tennessee has the lowest voter turnout in the country, and millions of Texans skipped voting in the last election — that has to change if we want to make a real difference. **_[Tomorrow, October 7th, is the deadline to register to vote. So, we’re asking you to do something today — consider throwing your support behind Gloria and Colin with a donation of any amount. ---
Hi Peter,

Recently, the Center for American Women and Politics (CAWP) released a stunning report: the number of women running for Congress in 2024 is **_far less_** than it has been in previous election cycles (facts and figures below).

This trend is disturbing. We cannot lose ground on all the progress women have made over the past century. As we work to reverse this trend, we understand the urgency to elect the candidates who HAVE made the bold decision to run. We need to work harder than ever to ensure they win on Election Day.

[**Join our effort to reverse this trend by pitching in $20.24. →**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94422217/503434781/-430846434?refcode=EM_F_241006cawp_N_CD_NO_10_G_N_L1&amount=20.24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk4ZWFhYmE1LWYzODMtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=sbnZuw3RKADRKEupGTjVXC0p0vQYAPcujzP7XAuXHkU=)

**Let’s look at the numbers:**

In 2020, 298 women ran for the U.S. House of Representatives. This year, **that number dropped to 256.** _Women only make up 23% of all candidates and nominees in election 2024_ , Republican women are an even smaller percentage of their party’s candidates – making up a mere 15.7% of House nominees.

Dangerous laws about women’s bodies are being crafted by rooms full of men across the country. We desperately need more women in those rooms.
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/94422220/503434783/-430846434?refcode=EM_F_241006cawp_N_CD_NO_10_G_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk4ZWFhYmE1LWYzODMtZWYxMS04NDc0LTYwNDViZGE4YWFlOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=sbnZuw3RKADRKEupGTjVXC0p0vQYAPcujzP7XAuXHkU=)
---
As the report points out, while the number of women running for office is down, _the forecast for female representation in the House and Senate will depend on what happens this November._

It’s not an exaggeration to say that the results of this election will make-or-break the future wellbeing of women in America. That’s why Her Bold Move is providing women candidates with the wide range of support they **need** to win their elections.

It’s harder to run for office as a woman. Women candidates are more likely to be subjected to sexual harassment, sexism, misogyny, double standards, and even death threats. But electing women to the rooms where decisions about our bodies are being made **__is as important as ever._ A little over a century ago, women couldn’t even vote, a little over half a century ago, women couldn’t open their own credit cards. We have truly come SO FAR – and we WILL NOT go back._**

But in 2020, 298 women...| | | | | = Hi Peter, Recently, the Center for American Women and Politics (CAWP) released a stunning report: the number of women running for Congress in 2024 is far less than it has been in previous election cycles (facts and figures below). This trend is disturbing. We cannot lose ground on all the progress women have made over the past century. As we work to reverse this trend, we understand the urgency to elect the candidates who HAVE made the bold decision to run. We need to work harder than ever to ensure they win on Election Day. = Let’s look at the numbers: In 2020, 298 women ran for the U.S. House of Representatives. This year, that number dropped to 256. Women only make up 23% of all candidates and nominees in election 2024 , Republican women are an even smaller percentage of their party’s candidates – making up a mere 15.7% of House nominees. Dangerous laws about women’s bodies are being crafted by rooms full of men across the country. We desperately need more women in those rooms. = As the report points out, while the number of women running for office is down, the forecast for female representation in the House and Senate will depend on what happens this November. It’s not an exaggeration to say that the results of this election will make-or-break the future wellbeing of women in America. That’s why Her Bold Move is providing women candidates with the wide range of support they need to win their elections. It’s harder to run for office as a woman. Women candidates are more likely to be subjected to sexual harassment, sexism, misogyny, double standards, and even death threats. But electing women to the rooms where decisions about our bodies are being made is as important as ever. A little over a century ago, women couldn’t even vote, a little over half a century ago, women couldn’t open their own credit cards. I’ll get straight to the point: **[Can you pitch in $5.80 to help us reach voters across California’s 58 counties before November?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2845?c0=oct2024_abs_em.Ozcc5f&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20241006_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=7805%2E5257348%2EpvS0ez)**

We’re in the final stretch, with just 30 days until Election Day. Reaching voters across all of California’s 58 counties in this limited time will require _a lot_ of resources.

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Angry and adrift, at the mercy of his whims, Trump campaign spokesperson lashes out at me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the New Democrat Coalition Action Fund
body:
| Team — you can hear the spitting anger and desperation from Donald Trump’s campaign in their increasingly desperate attacks.

As they frantically search for _something,**anything**_ they can tether to a coherent campaign message with time running out until this election, they picked a familiar target — yours truly. “**Shifty Schiff** has no right to talk about morals, considering he’s one of the most **despicable** and **disgusting** elected officials in Congress.” All because I called Trump out on _CNN_ for flip-flopping on the fundamental right to abortion — no less than 4 times in _48 hours._ **His willingness to change his stance every 15 minutes on a matter this serious shows that in addition to opposing women’s reproductive freedoms, he has no moral compass or values at** **all. He only believes in his own self-interest.**

But as Trump’s spokesperson saw it, that wasn’t an indictment of their candidate, but of those willing to confront him — the same old story for Trump’s entire political career.

body:
From ruby red to dem blue: Every County, Every Vote
#
Derek, **THIS IS IT.** I need you fired up! 🔥
Voting has BEGUN in Pennsylvania, and we have just 30 days left until Election Day. **[Can you pitch in $5 to support Democrats over this final stretch?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20241006?refcode=em20241006-9456&refcode2=9456_434096_xDEz6W&akid=9456%2E434096%2ExDEz6W)**
Let me be crystal clear: We NEED to show up and **VOTE.** We need to support our Democratic champions and defend our hard-won progress at the ballot box.
The Frontline Five (Bob Casey, Jon Tester, Jacky Rosen, Sherrod Brown, and Tammy Baldwin) need our votes to keep the Senate 🔵 and 🛑 a GOP takeover.
Kamala Harris and Tim Walz are counting on us to vote for their people-first agenda and keep Donald Trump and JD Vance OUT of the White House.
And local Democratic candidates – from school boards to Congress – fighting on the frontlines for our values cannot win their CRUCIAL races without our votes.
Now, I know what some of you might be thinking: "I'm in a conservative area. How does my vote matter?" Listen up, because this is important:
**If it didn't matter, the other side wouldn't try so hard to make it harder for you to vote and make your voice heard.**
Here's the reality: **Pennsylvania is _THE_ tipping point in 2024** – for the Senate, the White House, and the direction our nation will go. We have a real chance to win here, but it's only gonna happen if we ALL show up and do our part. 💪💪💪
I've been out in ruby red counties, and let me tell you – the energy has been OFF THE CHARTS. If we vote in high enough numbers, we can win all over the map.
Remember: **EVERY COUNTY + EVERY VOTE MATTERS.** Period.
Not all that long ago, California was solidly Republican and Texas was a Democratic stronghold. Things can change and the tides can turn ANYWHERE if enough people show up to vote. Our votes have the power to shift the political landscape, for better or worse! That’s why it’s so important that we show up.
**[We CAN do this. But I need to know: Are you with me? Donate $5 now to help spread the word and get out the vote for our Democratic candidates!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20241006?refcode=em20241006-9456&refcode2=9456_434096_xDEz6W&akid=9456%2E434096%2ExDEz6W)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20241006?amount=5&refcode=em20241006-9456&refcode2=9456_434096_xDEz6W&akid=9456%2E434096%2ExDEz6W)**
Thank you for being in this fight,
💙 John
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

_P.S. Remember, no county is too small, rural, or "too red" for us to count out. Every vote matters. This is how we'll keep PA, the Senate + the White House blue 🔵 in 2024._

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20241006-9456-footer&t=1&refcode2=9456_434096_xDEz6W&akid=9456%2E434096%2ExDEz6W)**

Our top recommendation in portable solar generators is the . THIS breakthrough solar generator is safe enough to use inside. And never needs gas, ever. And you'll have peace of mind knowing that you and your family have a safe, reliable and easy-to-use source of backup power. To survive a blackout, storm, grid-down event... or worse. It's why the Patriot Power Generator was recently featured on Fox & Friends... FOX & FRIENDS FEATURES BREAKTHROUGH SOLAR GENERATOR Fox & Friends featured a breakthrough solar generator right before a "polar vortex" sent thousands of Americans into total darkness. Skip Bedell recommended it as the perfect gift to prepare for winter storms. And then BOOM! Demand surged and 4Patriots sold out of generators. Then a massive ice storm hit the nation. The folks who were fortunate enough to claim their silent, fume-free solar generator were thanking their lucky stars. Because despite power outages, rolling blackouts and bone-chilling temperatures... Those who acted fast and got their had peace of mind and could power critical devices like lights, space heaters, communications, critical medical devices and even fridges and freezers. Sadly, those who didn't prepare were left to hope and pray the lights came back on soon. YOUR LIFELINE: THE NEW & IMPROVED PATRIOT POWER GENERATOR 2000X The Patriot Power Generator 2000X now has double the capacity, more power, and newly expandable than our previous best-selling model. It was designed to safely and dependably meet your power needs. And best of all, it harnesses the power of the sun to keep a state-of-the-art lithium-iron-phosphate battery charged, so it delivers life-saving power for FREE. Unlike other generators, you'll never run out of gas. You'll have a power supply that you can recharge endlessly. And its portability is a huge advancement over chunky gas generators, or home-installed systems. You can take the Patriot Power Generator 2000X with you if you are forced out of your home. You'll have an ample supply of AC electricity available to power your fridge, freezer, or medical devices. Even your coffee maker... power your cell phones, computers, radios... and so much more. You can even use it to power an electric blanket to keep you warm. NO DEADLY FUMES, AND SILENTLY STEALTHY The Patriot Power Generator 2000X is a completely self-contained system that silently provides up to 2,000 continuous watts of totally FREE, renewable power. And it's so easy to use a child can use it. 1. Unfold and set up the solar panel in the sunlight. 2. Plug in the solar panel. 3. Now plug in your electronic devices and enjoy free power from the sun! Amazingly, it takes just 6 hours to fully charge via AC cord. It holds a charge for up to a year. PLEASE DON'T WAIT TO LEARN MORE But don't delay. We can't keep these generators in stock. Once we run out, it could be a while before we can get you one. To your survival, Frank Bates Patriot Headquarters P.S. Charities like Fisher House, A Soldier's Child Foundation, Team Rubicon and Operation Homefront. CUSTOMERS ARE RAVING ABOUT THEIR SOLAR GENERATOR Joe B. From Georgia to Michigan to Nevada, Black voters in swing states could decide who ends up in the White House and which party controls Congress.

clean_body: Trump and Fox News are laying the foundation for another January 6th Hi Peter, A new NPR poll out this week shows that most voters—6 in 10—are concerned or very concerned about election fraud. That includes a staggering 88% of Trump supporters. = Almost four years have passed, but Donald Trump hasn’t stopped lying about the results of the 2020 election. Just this week, during the Vice Presidential debate, Trump’s running mate, JD Vance, gave a “damning non-answer” when asked directly by Tim Walz if Trump truly won. At a Michigan rally on Thursday, Trump went even further, falsely claiming he won the state in 2020, despite losing Michigan by over 150,000 votes. Michigan, of course, was one of the states where Trump tried to overturn the results based on unsubstantiated fraud claims. And it doesn’t stop there. According to Media Matters , in the past three weeks, Fox News , Fox Business , and Newsmax have made over 141 baseless claims about non-citizens voting. These networks are pushing a dangerous lie that Democrats are encouraging non-citizens to vote to swing the election for Kamala Harris. Some hosts have even claimed that thousands of non-citizens have already voted. They’re combining Trump’s two favorite conspiracy theories—election denial and immigration—into one fear-mongering narrative, setting the stage to deny the results of the 2024 election. That’s the bad news. The good news is that COURIER is already fighting back. Our reporters in 11 battleground newsrooms are working year-round to push back against the right-wing lies and conspiracies that damage our democracy. Fellow Patriot, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Fellow Patriot, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=1b7b8c9f4bc94bf5b30271ccbc28df59&_e=Xmj5IR_Pc9pCRYoA6kZGEtNioRPQNIe-h6GabdIfUrFfK3fepHJ_cTuFDHIdJyXp_xGFmlDSG0vVjM-5ilplZzJnek0rPMHhbvPfJVd0aK5Bm_i9nuuJOkUB0ymiYmCUkqAVYvmk_pg_fSGcpanUMrHR2PyRajuJYDMm1THaCgdRxLHKT2hi_imYniEB0f7r7NNgPgDggTuhVxCPJq06lRE3JbgVScAy9Nbu5pb9dzDqwEtRn-qiViH5Ov10cjaAZKeO4FdLazB956t4qcjzX2e0ZDxoL7usl1E8sg_7cef7vfrKVfg61qWCzZ9znvTd)_

Fellow Patriot, I'm proud to say that _Right Wing Revolution_ is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before:
* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

* It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

* It's NOT a call for __ our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on __ how _all Americans_ can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving _ourselves_.
