A story about my birthday, and a special request
#
Hey Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce.
**[Before I ask you to make a donation of any amount toward my campaign to defeat Josh Hawley,](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/75102?refcode=em20241006-7952&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7952%2E614464%2Elm3cA-) I want to tell you what this day — October 6th, my birthday — always makes me think about.** Please let me explain.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/75102?refcode=em20241006-7952&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7952%2E614464%2Elm3cA-)
**I had a lot of great birthdays growing up, but my eighth birthday — October 6th, 1990 — was going to be something special.** That year, I was going to get a little sister!
There were already three of us kids but, since my parents were passionately Catholic at the time, we were born in fairly quick succession and rapidly vacillated between friends and enemies. A couple devastating miscarriages later, and we were so excited to have a little sister we could spend all our time doting and loving on.
My mother kept saying it was the easiest pregnancy ever, and we counted the days excitedly. Two days before my birthday, she was born.
We talked to my parents on the phone. Easiest one yet, my mom proclaimed, the timing was perfect, they hoped to be home for a birthday party. I really was getting a little sister for my birthday this year!
After school, my grandma hurried us to the hospital to meet our new little sister. We each got to hold her as doctors and nurses hustled this way and that. My mom and dad were tense. They told us our little sister just needed a few tests run.
Before we knew it, my little sister was on a helicopter to St. Louis, my parents following closely behind in our van. She was on the verge of dying and needed open heart surgery.
**That birthday did end up being memorable, but for all the wrong reasons.**
As an eight-year-old kid, it’s hard not to be selfish. I remember wondering how, if my sister died on my birthday, would I ever really get a birthday again?
We never did extravagant presents as kids, since times were always tight, but every year my mom or grandma would make us a special themed cake. A baseball, a butterfly, a clown holding balloons... something meaningful for us.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/75102?refcode=em20241006-7952&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7952%2E614464%2Elm3cA-)
That year, however, my grandma drove me to the grocery store and told me I could pick out any cake I wanted. I was sad, but also kind of excited — I spent hours as a kid ogling the grocery store desserts and wondering what they were like. I walked up and down the display, looking for the biggest brightest smash of frosting I could find. When I finally saw it, I just knew. It was a beautiful white cake with a massive pile of red flowers flowing out of one corner.
“Are you sure?” My grandma asked, as I told her it was the one. “It’s not really a birthday cake. But if you want it...”
Oh, I wanted it.
I don’t remember what present I got that year. But I remember eating every single ounce of that red flower frosting. How the red dye stained my fingers. And I remember how ridiculously sick I felt after gorging myself and how I swore I would never eat a bite of frosting again as long as I lived. An oath I’m sure I broke at the next family birthday. Although, to this day I don’t go heavy on icing and have flashbacks if I try.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/75102?refcode=em20241006-7952&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7952%2E614464%2Elm3cA-)
**My sister survived that open heart surgery, several ensuing health scares, another open-heart surgery, and more.** It’s hard to capture the toll that takes on a family. Mentally, emotionally, and financially.
I remember my mom crying herself to sleep not just because she wasn’t sure if her little girl would survive, but also because she had no idea how they were going to make it financially. Something that we could have never accomplished alone, and only did because we had a community behind us.
**All I want for my birthday this year is to make sure no family has to go through something like that again.[That’s why I’m asking you to make a donation of $10 to help me defeat Josh Hawley and take back Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat on November 5th:](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/75102?refcode=em20241006-7952&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7952%2E614464%2Elm3cA-)**

body:
My mom worked her whole life to provide for us. My sisters went to college and built successful lives in service to their own families and communities.
#

Peter —
My family means the world to me.
In my mom and my sisters, I see the American dream.
My mom worked her whole life to provide for us. My sisters went to college and built successful lives in service to their own families and communities.
We started with next to nothing. No money. No connections. But we made it, because the American dream is still alive.
There’s no doubt that it’s become more difficult to pursue, though. After I left the Marines, I knew my service to our country wasn’t over. I’ve dedicated the last 20 years of my life to strengthening the American dream and delivering for people who need help.
But people like Kari Lake, like Donald Trump, they’re only out for themselves. They’ll attack anyone who doesn’t fall in line. They’ll stop at nothing in their pursuit of power and influence.
This November is our best shot at rejecting the politics of Kari Lake and Donald Trump. I’m ready to do whatever I can to get us across the finish line, to defend Arizona and everything we’ve accomplished. But I can’t do this alone.
Please, Peter. Arizona starts voting in just three days. We’re going all out to reach voters before they submit their ballots, and I need your help.

Trump called them headaches. Downplayed their wounds. Now, we’ve learned that his administration slow-walked Purple Heart medals for the ones who were wounded so he wouldn’t get bad press for it.
#
Peter,
Trump wants you to think that no leader on earth would stand against him if he becomes president again.
But the best argument against that is what happened while he actually _was_ president.
Trump pulled us out of the Iran nuclear deal. That enabled Iran to refine nuclear material, and made us all less safe.
After Trump pulled out of the nuclear deal, attacks on US Troops by Iranian proxies increased 400 percent.
In retaliation for an assassination ordered by Trump, Iran launched a barrage of missiles at an American base in Iraq. More than 100 American Troops suffered traumatic brain injuries.
Trump called them headaches. Downplayed their wounds. Now, we’ve learned that his administration slow-walked Purple Heart medals for the ones who were wounded so he wouldn’t get bad press for it. It wasn’t until President Biden took office that the Purple Hearts were issued.
That’s all we are to him. Expendable. “Suckers” and “losers.”
The world is a far more dangerous place because of Trump, and if he regains the presidency it won’t just be the Active Duty at risk. Every American is going to be put in harm's way if Trump is allowed to restart his incoherent and chaotic foreign policy of brinkmanship and aggression.
We’re determined to prevent that from happening, and we’ll be working every single day from now until the election to stop Trump for good. There are thirty days to go. We have to make the most of them.

You've probably heard Bill Clinton's 1992 presidential campaign slogan, _"It's the Economy, Stupid."_ Clinton's political strategist, James Carville, posted it inside campaign headquarters to keep the team focussed and on the message.

The slogan is making a comeback in 2024 as Republicans highlight Kamala Harris's dismal economic record. But if you're a freedom-loving American, we have a different slogan for you.

**"It's the Senate, Stupid."**

Conservatives are rightly focused on the presidential race this year, but winning the White House – as critical as it is – won't be enough to save the country without a conservative Senate. Without the Senate, President Trump won't be able to confirm his appointees or enact his second-term agenda.
**A Republican president without a conservative Senate is simply a waste of a Republican president.**
**[**That's why we must take action right now to help elect the best Senate candidates across the nation.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=4c464907b3b54947a7bb36597492e8ac&_e=I0f_pClXbT21tE_cHWDbUw7nD5jRQXStgMNc2dkMbwxnGwAgqB2ENfGBtF9_c1ICGO9Bj5d9u10cLIXw40I--JGU6Bv4V-Y8_adktTgvDtLy-9bKMfnZL70aUkkPzgaUQpCBn8hMpf_1qEA3kA9C4eGg1syUiLwGw6jrcfAzMxa9-tXpDtMsozM8iozczAMKS8NAMcFbSAbGmJp0y6REhVIeXDpCDoD7cBreWIHxKLabrhhkADxS0Sb2CHmLh6yLAZAXM0MTqLAswoJciQX_pw%3D%3D)**
A president can campaign on good policies, but he doesn't write the bills. As long as liberals control the Senate, good legislation will never be signed into law.

_Does anyone think Chuck Schumer will ever send bills to President Trump's desk to secure our borders, grow our economy, expand American energy, and restore election integrity?_ Of course not. If we fail to win the Senate, none of these common-sense policies will be passed. And if Kamala Harris wins, we won't be able to stop Senate Democrats from nuking the filibuster, passing their extreme agenda without debate, and creating a permanent Democrat majority.

****As we head into the final days of this election, we must support the conservatives running for U.S. Senate.**** These eight candidates believe in the principles of freedom that make America great and are willing to fight for them. subject: Heck of a job, Kamala
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
Billions for war, crumbs for disaster victims

| | | [ ](jillstein2024.com/)
---
Peter, The devastation wrought by Hurricane Helene in the Southeast can’t be overstated. There are thousands of people who are cut off from the outside world, trying to survive without food, without fresh water, without access to vital medical care. There are still many missing and the real death toll isn’t yet known. Disasters like this show that climate crisis is not some future hypothetical, climate crisis is here now.

Kamala Harris made a brief appearance in North Carolina to say the government was ready to give $750 to survivors who qualified - a paltry amount that will barely begin to cover survivors’ urgent needs. The Biden-Harris administration has no problem sending billions upon billions of dollars of taxpayer dollars to fund their proxy war in Ukraine and Israel’s genocidal land grabs. But when disaster strikes the American people, they throw a few crumbs along with their thoughts and prayers.

We’ve already seen this callous response too many times. Flint, Michigan still doesn’t have clean water after a decade. The victims of the wildfires in Lahaina, Hawaii were given a mere $700. The residents of East Palestine, Ohio are still being poisoned. Our government puts corporate greed over human need and we’re all more vulnerable than ever before. When George W. Bush ignored and insulted the victims of Hurricane Katrina in New Orleans back in 2005, the Democratic Party was up in arms. Now they’re busy making excuses as the Biden-Harris administration responds with the same indifference and neglect to the victims of Helene.

It doesn’t have to be this way. We need transformative change and real democracy that works for the people. We need a real Green New Deal to prepare for the climate disasters that are already in the pipeline, and to keep these disasters from getting much worse. We need to take our money that’s going to bomb people around the world and invest it here at home to take care of our people and fix our crumbling infrastructure. Stein/Ware is the only choice that is prepared to address these life and death issues on day one of their administration. [**

Peter _, the American people have shown time and time again that we’ll be there for each other when we’re in need even as our government turns their backs on us to enrich their billionaire donors at the expense of the people. Can you dig deep today to help the victims of Hurricane Helene survive in these trying times?_**](https://jillsteinforpresident.nationbuilder.com/r?u=U1tCKeUd9dxH3UTTI6NyCjvP88ZOBpH35cVrYfVM0jSwtLSQ-UA9xkn3PGmMQS2r&e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=helene_response_no_fundraising&n=1)

The phrase "most consequential election of our lifetime" gets thrown around a lot, but that's exactly what we're facing in 2024. In just under a month, the American people will decide whether they want to build on the progress Democrats have made on everything from cutting health care and drug costs, to tackling the climate crisis, or if they want to re-elect Donald Trump and usher in what is sure to be another presidency laser-focused on gutting our rights to privacy, rolling back the basic rights of women to make their own health care decisions, and so much more. With the help of Senate Republicans, Donald Trump was able to confirm three brand new Supreme Court justices to the bench during his first presidency. Each one of them talked a big game about upholding legal precedent during their confirmation hearings in the Senate when it came to landmark cases like Roe v. Wade. Every single one of them threw their oaths in the trash can at the earliest opportunity to roll back decades of precedent and protections for Americans' fundamental freedoms. And now, Republicans are ready and eager to pack our judicial system full of even morefar-right judges. I am deeply concerned about the future of our country if Republicans get their way. If Donald Trump wins, a Democratic majority in the Senate would be the only thing standing between Trump and his goal of gaining a majority on the Supreme Court. ### Hillary is Dodging a Debate!

After consistent outreaches by Team Hudson to schedule a debate, Hillary Scholten seems more interested in hiding behind millions of dollars in campaign ad spending than actually facing Paul in a debate. It is profoundly anti-democratic to refuse to debate in one of the most competitive districts in the country in the epicenter of the political universe this election.
Paul stands ready to debate any time.
---
|
### Campaigning Around the District With Rep. Moolenaar & Rep. Walberg
###

On Tuesday Paul was joined by Rep. Moolenaar and his team to knock doors in Rockford. It is great to see the momentum building around this race as great Republican leaders like John Moolenaar are joining the fight to win back this historically Republican MI-3 seat.
Additionally, Team Hudson had the privilege of being joined by another great Michigan congressman. Rep. Tim Walberg joined the campaign for a day in Grand Rapids and Muskegon on Wednesday. Thanks to Rep. Walberg for taking the time to share with voters throughout the district the importance of winning this seat back.
West Michigan has a strong tradition of common-sense fiscal conservative leaders such as President Gerald R. Ford, Vern Ehlers, and Paul Henry. Model legislators who knew how to work across the aisle and get the job done. Team Hudson is working hard every day to make sure West Michigan returns to the representation it deserves on January 1, 2025!

The TX voter registration deadline is tomorrow. Your support can help us reach more voters.
#
Tomorrow is the voter registration deadline in Texas, and we need your help to make sure every eligible Texan has the opportunity to make their voice heard in the upcoming election.
For weeks now, I've been crisscrossing our great state, visiting college campuses and communities with our dedicated team of volunteers. Our mission? To register as many new Democratic voters as possible. The energy and enthusiasm we've encountered have been truly inspiring, but there's still work to be done.
**Here's where you come in.** The work we're doing to elect Democrats up and down the ballot is entirely funded by supporters like you. Whether it's $5, $10, or $25, your contribution can make a real difference in our ability to reach and register voters before tomorrow's deadline.
Next month, we have a chance to elect leaders who will fight for the issues that matter most to working families in Texas. But to make that happen, we need to ensure that as many voters as possible are registered and ready to cast their ballot.
[**Can you chip in right now to help us reach more potential voters before tomorrow's registration deadline?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20241006.s8fi6q&refcode=ema20241006-239837&t=1&akid=239837%2E444211%2ER8PlxY)
**[DONATE $3](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20241006.s8fi6q&refcode=ema20241006-239837&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=239837%2E444211%2ER8PlxY)**
Every day counts. Every conversation matters. And with your help, we can ensure that more Texans than ever before are ready to make their voices heard at the ballot box.
Thank you for your commitment to our democracy and for being a crucial part of this movement.
Together, we can build a better Texas for all.
Thank you,
Beto O'Rourke

Do me a favor and imagine this for a second. Imagine waking up on November 6th, and a climate change denier has just been elected president (_again_). Climate change deniers have taken back the U.S. Senate and taken over your local city council. body:
Take actions throughout the week to prepare to vote.

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTE1OTIzMDMS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjA4MDA3NzgxMwS2&mt=1&rt=0).
| | | |
---
|
* * *
---
| | | | Dear Peter,
---
| | **Are you ready to cast your ballot in the upcoming election?** The health of our planet and the health of our democracy are inextricably linked — and those most impacted by the climate crisis are also facing the greatest barriers to voting. That’s why we’re celebrating [**_National Voter Education Week_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/k_ypT77bV7tY/ZXBwNmJWWllWaWhrNUh0eEVWdmFnVnJWczR0dytXMVgwbHlkY2tmdWJEbDRHK29hL1d3anVReEFUVy9zVzl1cXJoWENwWkg4YU1oOEZHeVZGMm8yNGxCK05Qd3N1WVdPZFJxclRvZXRDakU9S0/) this week to help voters in our community bridge the gap between registering to vote and casting their ballot.
---
| | Throughout the week, everyone is encouraged to take different actions, bringing you one step closer to becoming a confident voter. Here some of the actions you can take to celebrate National Voter Education Week:
---
| |
### [**_Register to Vote_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/L6b_)
✅ [**_Check your registration status_**](https://links.messages.lcv.) and your state’s voter registration deadlines.
---
| | 🗳️ If you’re not registered yet, or you need to update your voter registration, [**_become a registered voter!_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/NvbyBGGpYGC_)
---
| |
### [**_Get to Know Your Ballot_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/3Z0ec--Kw-JG/ZXBwNmJWWllWaWhrNUh0eEVWdmFnVnJWczR0dytXMVgwbHlkY2tmdWJEbDRHK29hL1d3anVReEFUVy9zVzl1cXJoWENwWkg4YU1oOEZHeVZGMm8yNGxCK05Qd3N1WVdPZFJxclRvZXRDakU9S0/)
📖 [**_Read up on the candidates, positions, and ballot measures_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/2zZrMNN-pNCa/ZXBwNmJWWllWaWhrNUh0eEVWdmFnVnJWczR0dytXMVgwbHlkY2tmdWJEbDRHK29hL1d3anVReEFUVy9zVzl1cXJoWENwWkg4YU1oOEZHeVZGMm8yNGxCK05Qd3N1WVdPZFJxclRvZXRDakU9S0/) in easy-to-understand language.
---
| | 💾 Print out, screenshot, or otherwise save your choices for each item on your ballot.
---
| |
### [**_Make a Plan to Vote_**](https://links.messages.lcv.)
🏛️ Ask yourself HOW you plan to vote: [**_By mail_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/j9y2f00A_), [**_in person_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/KybpT--74-) early or on Election Day?
---
| | 📅 Ask yourself WHEN you plan to vote: [**_Add it to your calendar today!_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~)
---
| |
### [**_Understand the Process_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/ebDKc88j98fq/ZXBwNmJWWllWaWhrNUh0eEVWdmFnVnJWczR0dytXMVgwbHlkY2tmdWJEbDRHK29hL1d3anVReEFUVy9zVzl1cXJoWENwWkg4YU1oOEZHeVZGMm8yNGxCK05Qd3N1WVdPZFJxclRvZXRDakU9S0/)
📚 [**_Learn more about how elections are run in your state_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/X6bzs~~9V~M6/ZXBwNmJWWllWaWhrNUh0eEVWdmFnVnJWczR0dytXMVgwbHlkY2tmdWJEbDRHK29hL1d3anVReEFUVy9zVzl1cXJoWENwWkg4YU1oOEZHeVZGMm8yNGxCK05Qd3N1WVdPZFJxclRvZXRDakU9S0/) and ways you can get involved in our democracy like [**_poll working_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/rNykfEE2kEt7/ZXBwNmJWWllWaWhrNUh0eEVWdmFnVnJWczR0dytXMVgwbHlkY2tmdWJEbDRHK29hL1d3anVReEFUVy9zVzl1cXJoWENwWkg4YU1oOEZHeVZGMm8yNGxCK05Qd3N1WVdPZFJxclRvZXRDakU9S0/) and [**poll monitoring.**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/vNR6fEEgeEtG/ZXBwNmJWWllWaWhrNUh0eEVWdmFnVnJWczR0dytXMVgwbHlkY2tmdWJEbDRHK29hL1d3anVReEFUVy9zVzl1cXJoWENwWkg4YU1oOEZHeVZGMm8yNGxCK05Qd3N1WVdPZFJxclRvZXRDakU9S0/)
---
| | 🧠 [**_Help fight misinformation and disinformation_**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/04wrM88pW8fNN/ZXBwNmJWWllWaWhrNUh0eEVWdmFnVnJWczR0dytXMVgwbHlkY2tmdWJEbDRHK29hL1d3anVReEFUVy9zVzl1cXJoWENwWkg4YU1oOEZHeVZGMm8yNGxCK05Qd3N1WVdPZFJxclRvZXRDakU9S0/) in your community.

By 2009, my colleagues chose me to serve as mayor, making me the youngest openly gay Asian American mayor in the nation. At 26, I had a lot to learn, but I also had a lot to give:

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94435754/503477149/-1808454379?refcode=BLU_EM_LOW_2024-10-06_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMDk4NTMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWQ4NDFjYzktMGM4NC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=2R-VXVIySoCjAWuLUA95saoBc59hzW4UQ9qgVr-9BZo=)

| Folks,

When I was first elected to the Campbell City Council in 2006, I was just a young guy with a lot of passion and big ideas.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94435756/503477151/-1808454379?refcode=BLU_EM_LOW_2024-10-06_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMDk4NTMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOWQ4NDFjYzktMGM4NC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=2R-VXVIySoCjAWuLUA95saoBc59hzW4UQ9qgVr-9BZo=) _Me while running for mayor, age 26_

I’m going to share a story with you that I’ve never talked about publicly — because given the stakes of this upcoming election, I believe it’s important to contribute to this critical conversation. After being married for a few years, Andrea and I, like many young couples, made the very personal decision to start a family. I can still remember the moment she told me one morning coming back to bed that maybe the migraine she had been suffering from had something to do with her being pregnant. It was hard not to burst with excitement even though she wasn’t feeling well. That excitement grew over the next few weeks as we settled into the planning and preparation and counted down to the due date. We talked about how our lives would change and, as all prospective parents do, imagined what our child would be like. All of that ended abruptly one morning when I got a call from Andrea following her week 10 doctor’s appointment. They could no longer detect a heartbeat. She had had a miscarriage. We were devastated. We went into this experience with a great deal of thought and deliberation but the emotional attachment so early into it caught me off guard. All of this was very personal and private — we hadn’t even told our friends and family that Andrea was pregnant. We had each other to lean on and we decided that even through this loss, we were still committed to having a family. Fortunately, Andrea was able to get pregnant again and we started the process all over again, albeit with a bit more trepidation. We made it through the first trimester this time and felt confident in sharing the news with our friends and family and started to allow ourselves to feel the same excitement as before. One Saturday afternoon, we were preparing to walk to our friend’s house for a summer BBQ. I knocked on our bathroom door to see if Andrea was ready to go and I could hear her crying. She opened the door and told me that she was miscarrying. We were devastated again. It was the longest weekend while we waited for Andrea to see our doctor to confirm what we suspected. On Monday, I got a call from Andrea following her appointment. There was a heartbeat! The fetus was still viable. There was a subchorionic hemorrhage that had caused bleeding leading us to believe that it was a miscarriage. This made the pregnancy uncertain. The next few months consisted of us holding our breath at every appointment, waiting to confirm there was still a strong heartbeat. In December of 2004, our daughter Amelia was born. She was a fighter, and seeing Andrea hold her in her arms, worn from almost 24 hours of labor but with a look of pure love and exhaustion, was perhaps the most beautiful thing I have ever seen. Our experience, while difficult, ended happily. For many couples the struggle is much more severe, the pregnancies much more complex and the outcomes don’t always end well. We were fortunate to be able to have each other along with the guidance and care of remarkable medical professionals to help us navigate and manage this experience. **That is how these decisions should be made. They are private and personal, and everyone’s experiences are different. They should be guided by their own values and consciences along with the consultation of their trusted medical providers.** You don’t need me to tell you that there are politicians in this country — including right here in OR-06 — who want to take away our ability to make these decisions for ourselves, who want to insert themselves into these deeply personal and heartbreaking moments that so many families face. **It should ALWAYS be the woman’s choice and she should ALWAYS have the freedom to make those decisions. ## **ISRAEL GRIEVES BUT STANDS STRONG**
---
Tomorrow marks one year since **the largest number of Jewish civilians were killed in one day since the Holocaust**. The world said, “Never again,” yet the blood of 1,300 men, women, and children _cries out from the ground_. October 7, 2023 is hardly just a memory because the bloodshed has not ended. Rockets, missiles, attack drones, and more are being used as tools of carnage and destruction against the people of Israel**to this day**. And more than 100 hostages remain in captivity. But not every story is a sad one. Some are tremendously inspiring. Thousands of paramedics, EMTs, soldiers, police, and everyday civilians found themselves in extraordinary circumstances and **took heroic actions to save lives.** Some gave their last measure of courage in the process. The men and women of **MAGEN DAVID ADOM,** Israel’s emergency services system, have saved tens of thousands of lives in the last 365 days. Yet, 38 of these brave medical professionals have lost their own lives in the process, averaging one loss every 10 days. This is a time of tears and tenacity in Israel. A day to remember those who were lost, taken, and broken on October 7 and over the past year. And a day to take courage and “strengthen the feeble hands, steady the knees that give way.” It is a day to remember that the spirit of the people of Israel will not be broken by rockets and terror attacks. **And a day to remember that God Almighty still fights for Israel.** Any minute we are expecting the next wave of attacks. Some believe they will be of tremendous intensity. But one thing is certain, the paramedics and EMTs of **MAGEN DAVID ADOM** stand at the ready. They are almost entirely funded by private donors, friends like you, who helped them make it this far. And we pray that you will stand with Israel today. Please [give a special October 7 offering](https://track.americanpatriotdailynews.com/?xtl=15zlcw1celd6xi85vgyivx8vc8lwngm86g1gp02p3agu518kuo2fcnxkb26uuv1efl1jhbj07nu7telvkoe1j15kdrcei8aenin3kyvhd5nnavsyotypzgfvpu6qbnveylaw7gtpa5kuaqcftjis16q42yric917534uui42s9q6y0sbzfdtt&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sky6ma&__onlt=h) right now to help save lives in Israel. Your support provides the emergency supplies and medical equipment these brave men and women must have **the very moment the next attack is launched**. Just as they did last October 7, they will need to respond immediately, day or night, possibly to dozens, maybe hundreds of attacks at once. **This lifesaving work is only possible with your support. God bless you for blessing Israel.**

Friend, every Sunday my mom and I spend the afternoon playing dominoes together. It's our special tradition — and it's one of the most meaningful parts of my life.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94438201/503484372/849749119?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk2149-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjk0ZjhlNzktMTQ4NC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=nZy3uyFxU9jO6pk965Mfez9ytlqSvcDefMm1QaaFxOE=)
I owe just about everything in my life to my mom. She made the brave decision to move my family from our home in Ecuador to America. It wasn't easy moving to a new country as a 14-year-old, but I can't imagine what it was like for my mom, having to start all over and working double shifts just to pay rent for a one room apartment.
But friend, my mom never wavered once. **Her constant reassurance, work ethic, and firm belief in the American dream inspired me to fight for a better life.**
I studied hard, got a minimum wage job, and earned scholarships to pay for college. After school, I found a career giving back to my community through public service, eventually becoming the first South American immigrant elected to Congress. I've found purpose in my life, become part of a unique community, and raised a beautiful family.
**Because of my mom's sacrifices, my family got our American dream. And now, it's both a privilege and a joy to be my mom's caretaker, ensuring that she can age with dignity and comfort.** There are a lot of big things that come along with that job — managing her doctor's appointments, advocating for her care, and navigating the all-too-complicated Medicare and Social Security systems.
But it's the little parts of caring for my mom — playing our weekly domino games, cooking a big dinner for her, taking her on trips to her favorite places — that matter most to me.
My ability to give my mom a good retirement is one of the things that I am most grateful for. It's not easy by any means, but I know all too well just how lucky my mom and I are. **These days, it's getting harder and harder for Americans to age with dignity and comfort.**
Far-right Republicans have fought for major cuts to Social Security and blocked efforts to expand Medicare, leaving seniors living paycheck to paycheck. Instead they want to cut or privatize these critical public programs — my opponent Rick Scott actually came up with a plan to _end_ them altogether. Even though I've been able to give my mom a good retirement, the shortcomings of these programs still make it incredibly hard to get her the care and support she needs.
**Every American deserves a good, stable retirement. clean_body: Screenshot 2024-10-06 at 12.31.48 PM | | | Friend, every Sunday my mom and I spend the afternoon playing dominoes together. It's our special tradition — and it's one of the most meaningful parts of my life. = I owe just about everything in my life to my mom. She made the brave decision to move my family from our home in Ecuador to America. It wasn't easy moving to a new country as a 14-year-old, but I can't imagine what it was like for my mom, having to start all over and working double shifts just to pay rent for a one room apartment. But friend, my mom never wavered once. Her constant reassurance, work ethic, and firm belief in the American dream inspired me to fight for a better life. I studied hard, got a minimum wage job, and earned scholarships to pay for college. After school, I found a career giving back to my community through public service, eventually becoming the first South American immigrant elected to Congress. I've found purpose in my life, become part of a unique community, and raised a beautiful family. Because of my mom's sacrifices, my family got our American dream. And now, it's both a privilege and a joy to be my mom's caretaker, ensuring that she can age with dignity and comfort. There are a lot of big things that come along with that job — managing her doctor's appointments, advocating for her care, and navigating the all-too-complicated Medicare and Social Security systems. But it's the little parts of caring for my mom — playing our weekly domino games, cooking a big dinner for her, taking her on trips to her favorite places — that matter most to me. My ability to give my mom a good retirement is one of the things that I am most grateful for. It's not easy by any means, but I know all too well just how lucky my mom and I are. These days, it's getting harder and harder for Americans to age with dignity and comfort. Far-right Republicans have fought for major cuts to Social Security and blocked efforts to expand Medicare, leaving seniors living paycheck to paycheck. Instead they want to cut or privatize these critical public programs — my opponent Rick Scott actually came up with a plan to end them altogether. Even though I've been able to give my mom a good retirement, the shortcomings of these programs still make it incredibly hard to get her the care and support she needs. Every American deserves a good, stable retirement. name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: We just made a risky decision.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC
body:
Hi Peter --
Our campaign just made a risky decision to launch new ads -- _even though the money wasn’t originally in our budget._
It wasn’t a decision we made lightly. But it was a necessary one.
My opponent and dark money super PACs have been relentlessly targeting me with misleading attack ads. _Just turn on any TV in Wisconsin and you’ll know what I’m talking about..._
**Their ad blitz proves to be working too -- with five recent polls showing this race tightening to within the margin of error, and RealClearPolitics even downgrading our race to a “Toss Up.” **
If we can’t make up the unexpected deficit in our budget, we could have to pull back our ad reservations or make cuts to our critical voter outreach efforts.
This is the wrong time to be scaling back, Peter, so I’m hoping you can help us close the gap:
**[Can I count on you to split a donation of any amount between Bob Casey and my campaign to help us respond to the flood of Republican attacks I’m facing?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20241006-4?refcode=em20241006-4&refcode2=4468_552475_LiAx9H&akid=4468%2E552475%2ELiAx9H)**

Thanks for your support, today and always.
-- Tammy

subject: If you’ve been waiting for the perfect moment to make your first contribution to help elect Democrats, this is it.
body:
Can we count on you today?
---
Derek, If you’ve been waiting for the perfect moment to make your first contribution to help elect Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats up and down the ballot, we’re here to tell you that this is it. We know your inbox is probably full of requests like these, and you might be wondering, “Why should I donate to you today? What will you do with my contribution?" Of course, there are the big reasons you’re hearing about all the time: defending our democracy, protecting our freedoms, and making sure Trump never gets the chance to enact his Project 2025 agenda. subject: A busy week on the campaign trail 🏃🏾‍♀️
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20241006-4373-footer&t=1001&akid=4373%2E420207%2ECkbgVy ]Pramila Jayapal

What a week, Peter!

We’re officially at the height of campaign season, so we’re as busy as
ever working to get out the vote. And with less than one month to go until
Election Day, we’re counting on your grassroots support to keep up the
pace.

Read on to see what Pramila’s been up to for the past week, and then
[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241006?refcode=em20241006&amount=3&refcode2=4373_420207_CkbgVy&akid=4373%2E420207%2ECkbgVy ]pitch in $3 or any amount you can to support our
organizers as they work to mobilize voters all over the country!

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241006?refcode=em20241006&amount=3&refcode2=4373_420207_CkbgVy&akid=4373%2E420207%2ECkbgVy ][IMG]

On Tuesday night, Pramila joined voters in Washington to watch the vice
presidential debate. JD Vance’s refusal to admit that Donald Trump lost
the 2020 election was pretty revealing (and utterly disqualifying), and
Tim Walz was right to call him out on it. Tim will be a vice president we
can all be proud of.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241006?refcode=em20241006&amount=3&refcode2=4373_420207_CkbgVy&akid=4373%2E420207%2ECkbgVy ][IMG]

Pramila also joined members of the Machinists Union on the picket line.
They’re striking for better wages, benefits, and pensions — and it’s time
for Boeing to come to the table and give workers a fair deal.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241006?refcode=em20241006&amount=3&refcode2=4373_420207_CkbgVy&akid=4373%2E420207%2ECkbgVy ][IMG]

And yesterday, Pramila joined voters in Fulton County, Georgia for a
canvass launch with State Senator Nabilah Islam Parkes. We heard from
great speakers, ate great food, and enjoyed great music before kicking off
a long day of canvassing to get out the vote!

This people-powered campaign is working hard to make the most of these
last 30 days. We have a lot more voters to reach if we want to make sure
Pramila, Kamala Harris, and Democrats in tough districts all over win on
November 5th — and we’re counting on your grassroots support to do it.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241006?refcode=em20241006&amount=3&refcode2=4373_420207_CkbgVy&akid=4373%2E420207%2ECkbgVy ]Peter, if
you’re with us in this fight, will you pitch in $3 today to
help us keep growing our movement? We can’t do it without you!

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20241006?amount=3&refcode=em20241006-4373&refcode2=4373_420207_CkbgVy&akid=4373%2E420207%2ECkbgVy ]Contribute

In solidarity,

Team Jayapal

body:

If you’d like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.sethmagaziner.com/p/9_n7o1XMskam_GoKXFDAdg2?unsubscribedata=f1cBvOePWkrAno1gtnFM6eSFMffzH0fnqtp%2F4r6iY2aW6MGe0pOm2tJld0yWD1IiH5kChSNjqrR4JgOCu9kFhX6EC%2BOiG92kH9Cgx1AoMFlMvxOHwTcwcmwgODYUKr5k7s38lvvnRHeLepoq8eF8LlBsPXT%2BjG1N2aK5j5so0O9eoyhDCXfXTVSiibV3RuUYil8%2FV8OVny5BKjLK7S6eYRfnIksLNqGisJhHYexZ9JCaROSKrmXMUf9XENWcM9wVdjQsTvr5OkqwF3zIfV4XJStGLsn8Vs6kgdNQ0H0%2B15p5Xhm6OpGNgZZNfTRJMDl79wBe71nEKZlnxygyM8N0WX6T0kSDzAqo0WhIdfDH6LQ2kqFJN4236avnPMSJHSybz1uT6yWf5zJgwWjqAzlFmHRPWIQ36CHe7jYk98GRCw8NS0MYkR8AWLPMJYByF4NV)

Peter,

I have exciting news! In a big win for Rhode Island, up to $40 million of federal funding is coming to our state to support literacy programs and help students who have fallen behind with reading comprehension get back on track.

| | Dear Fellow American,

My name is Larry P. Arnn, and I serve as president of Hillsdale College. I'm writing to you today because you're a concerned American who keeps up with current events.

That means you know something is seriously wrong in too many of our nation's schools.

You understand that a fierce ideological battle is raging in classrooms nationwide, and our children are at risk.

**This is no accident.**

The far-Left, guided by a Marxist vision of a radically transformed society, has strategically targeted education, including K-12 classrooms across America.

That's why I'm asking you to complete the [**NATIONAL OPINION SURVEY ON THE MARXIST HIJACKING OF AMERICAN EDUCATION**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f5158a9184484ebea22ee4884c2bc812&_e=LZcpIzOrgSNkPe-YK6mEABbgenSACYmn7ZCCKcQP_H6XCTHMJs1qzRJtMlcbN2kWh19tJXIpUrkkV3qonAcZ8gisuXCRsm1iJuObKI5MUESw8iv2QKmZVNI0sjRQnFTRnkwpV26Vq63G8vH5LJvoR3OOUwu1PfhNBtob7A3I5Nzrk_ExweQOTWrbk3a6GLGENVZ0jEV3QeRglT12XYPaVvG-SKvAM_GcbnQcp6uBsBiymsUV_1Nyss6a9nonS5a1RBL7A-yMuDCDdLsSD8z5NR-31VrGK3jdx40RTKn-5m0zwaPdU8rO6NLB0TcRoFs2ADHAcAs1eInAJwSSBoqHUyJ0DRqJGVfhHMwxxHGWs1hD7J1e_RIzNThcLVm_8poic2aSyM1ZV-Fjpn2_XJZZvuc9RZroL3RqS6KiUn2XlJ36DvfQDQbSYd01Lve2dHRn).

You can complete your survey at this secure link:

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/marxist-hijacking-of-american-education-survey](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f5158a9184484ebea22ee4884c2bc812&_e=LZcpIzOrgSNkPe-YK6mEABbgenSACYmn7ZCCKcQP_H6XCTHMJs1qzRJtMlcbN2kWh19tJXIpUrkkV3qonAcZ8gisuXCRsm1iJuObKI5MUESw8iv2QKmZVNI0sjRQnFTRnkwpV26Vq63G8vH5LJvoR3OOUwu1PfhNBtob7A3I5Nzrk_ExweQOTWrbk3a6GLGENVZ0jEV3QeRglT12XYPaVvG-SKvAM_GcbnQcp6uBsBiymsUV_1Nyss6a9nonS5a1RBL7A-yMuDCDdLsSD8z5NX-Zgo9F9GKkIwTtDOncR5L2wByXalKbGwh4hLMPabvOECOF3Tqp3lOrNlXqT-lfdfvWn_HhBr66IthnNgnsEETi1UoEELLcooYeQDecnVBabUYhFjlPuOdbLH4bEch8VNz1PA7HsoHI4-keq5qhONEq1myfhXA9Ommpi5vix9K2)

**Your participation right now could not be more urgent.**

Hearing directly from informed Americans like you will be a great help to us, as well as to policymakers and opinion leaders at all levels.

**You may be shocked by the extreme and false ideas being taught in far too many schools today, such as ...**
* _America was founded on slavery, not freedom, and is systematically racist to this day._

* _White supremacy was woven into America at its founding._

* _Capitalism and free enterprise are sources of poverty and injustice._

* _Americans are not equal citizens but instead belong to one of two groups: "oppressors" or "oppressed." _

* _There is a variety of genders, and gender is changeable._

* _Free speech is dangerous, and speech labeled as "misinformation" should be censored. _

These are radical and anti-American ideas. So, it comes as no surprise that recent surveys show that younger citizens are increasingly drawn to socialism, anarchy, transgenderism, and other destructive ideologies.

**You may think the situation is hopeless. But there is something we can do together to turn the tide.**

Hillsdale College is leading a bold teaching effort to confront these false ideas on the battlefield of education. Since our founding in 1844, we have offered "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings ... of civil and religious liberty."

We're committed to providing young Americans with a proper grounding in American civics through our **SAVE AMERICAN EDUCATION CAMPAIGN**.

Our **SAVE AMERICAN EDUCATION CAMPAIGN** features free online courses, opening and guiding K-12 classical schools, _Imprimis_ --our free digest of liberty--and other educational outreach programs. The goal is to counter the spread of radical and anti-American ideas in our education system.

To help us do this, we would like to know what you and other informed Americans think about the radical agenda of the far-Left, which is pushed in K-12 schools, colleges and universities, businesses, government, and even the U.S. military.

So please help us today by [taking your personalized survey--](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=f5158a9184484ebea22ee4884c2bc812&_e=LZcpIzOrgSNkPe-YK6mEABbgenSACYmn7ZCCKcQP_H6XCTHMJs1qzRJtMlcbN2kWh19tJXIpUrkkV3qonAcZ8gisuXCRsm1iJuObKI5MUESw8iv2QKmZVNI0sjRQnFTRnkwpV26Vq63G8vH5LJvoR3OOUwu1PfhNBtob7A3I5Nzrk_ExweQOTWrbk3a6GLGENVZ0jEV3QeRglT12XYPaVvG-SKvAM_GcbnQcp6uBsBiymsUV_1Nyss6a9nonS5a1RBL7A-yMuDCDdLsSD8z5NfOkk01Lj9p2_NHA6SLrUiB0izq010Uq1VFsoTfxUKWF7312TBnDsBNBH96F6glP1vycjvIMPM20KoRpiHfEjuxqAzxx5oNtWA7DeeKKK016bWcz4H6r75GhDBpOYh_uhyTSP41LbsBW80sfU0oOjbUSCBj2f03xrAYTXdC64Foe)your answers will help to guide our **SAVE AMERICAN EDUCATION CAMPAIGN** , which promotes informed patriotism by educating young Americans.

I firmly believe, and I hope you agree, that a proper education--the kind of education that Hillsdale provides--is the key to preserving American liberty for our children and grandchildren.

At a time when the far-Left explicitly rejects the principles of America's founding--and seeks to expel those principles from our civic life and our major institutions--there is only one way to save America: EDUCATION.

Together, we can fight back with the truth.

Thank you for your time, and thank you in advance for your survey responses.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. We need to hear from informed patriots like you about the state of American education. Hillsdale College is leading a bold teaching effort to confront the false ideas of critical race theory, transgenderism, and socialism on the battlefield of education with our **SAVE AMERICAN EDUCATION CAMPAIGN**. But today, we need your help!

Will you let us know what you think by taking our **National Opinion Survey on the Marxist Hijacking of American Education**? The survey will take only a few minutes of your time and will help us to defend liberty against radical ideologies.

body:
| Can I tell you a story about my family farm, folks? [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81353?t=6&akid=17329%2E878179%2EoKMcNC) In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began.

He farmed the land until the early 1940s, and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later.

We’ve made a lot of progress here — Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage.

The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day.

When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet.

**These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the country.

[I’m running for reelection because there’s still work to be done. Just like my parents and grandparents on the family farm, when I commit to something, I see it through. Can you make a split donation of any amount today between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to help me keep up the fight in Washington?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81353?t=7&akid=17329%2E878179%2EoKMcNC)** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Jon Tester and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/81354?t=8&akid=17329%2E878179%2EoKMcNC)

I’ll leave you with one last truth about farming: Some years you get the right amount of rain, and things work out really well. Other years, you get a whole lot less.

That means it’s important to be prepared for any outcome, and to have a support system by your side when things get difficult. We don’t know what this campaign will look like, or what Republicans will throw our way over these final few months. But with your support, we’ll be ready.

I appreciate anything you’re able to pitch in. Thanks for your help, and I hope I make you proud.

— Jon

But then, something incredible happened: Vice President Harris personally called on this team to help get back on track...AND DONATIONS SOARED! Vice President Harris is fighting to move our country forward -- but here’s the problem: The New York Times recently released new polls of Georgia, Arizona, and North Carolina and unfortunately, Trump leads in all three states. And to make things worse, we’re currently being outspent in many of these states. It couldn’t be more important that we reach voters before Trump does -- especially with early voting underway. That takes serious resources. So, Peter, if you’ve been waiting to make your first donation to Kamala’s campaign, NOW is when it will have the greatest impact. The Vice President is counting on you to join the millions of grassroots supporters who have already given $25 to power this fight. # _YOU Can Help Us Defeat Susie Lee!_
Want to help Drew and make sure Republicans maintain control of the House of Representatives? We need your help! This race is going to be tight, and having supporters like you step up and lend a hand is vital!

Here are the **_TOP 4_ ways _YOU_ can get involved:**

**1. Donate: **Simply chipping in a few dollars to support our efforts is incredibly helpful. Whether it's $3 or $3,000, every donation makes a _huge_ difference! Just $18 buys coffee and donuts for volunteers! **You can contribute to the campaign [HERE](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=227f41846f&e=fc26432468)**.

**2. Host a Meet-and-Greet for Drew**: Hosting a Meet-and-Greet in your home for Drew and inviting your friends, family, and neighbors is one of the best ways to spread our message. Whether it’s a casual coffee meeting, a wine and cheese event, or a fun game night, we can make hosting easy. Interested in hosting a meet-and-greet? Email [info](mailto:info@drewfornevada.com?subject=Host%20a%20meet%20and%20greet)[@drewfornevada.com](mailto:linnea@drewfornevada.com?subject=I'd%20like%20to%20host%20a%20Meet%20%26%20Greet%20for%20Drew!).

**3. Volunteer for the Campaign:** #TeamDrew is the secret weapon that will get Drew elected to Congress. We're knocking on tens of thousands of doors, writing thousands of postcards, and making as many phone calls as possible to make this campaign a success. And we can't do it without you! Please visit** **[THIS](https://DrewForNevada.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=faca3bfedb5031bc3491ebbc8&id=8eafc502ca&e=fc26432468) link to join #TeamDrew as a volunteer.

**4. Put up a Yard Sign:** One of the easiest and most effective ways to support our campaign is by putting a "Drew Johnson for Congress" sign in your yard. Almost every HOA in Southern Nevada allows at least one campaign yard sign. Email your name and address to [info@DrewforNevada.com](mailto:info@drewfornevada.com?subject=I'd%20like%20a%20yard%20sign%2C%20please!) and we'll ship one at **NO COST** to you!

Peter, we have big goals for the fall. Election Day is less than _**ONE MONTH AWAY**_ , and there's so much work to be done to make sure we elect champions for our community at every level of government. Here are four things we're working towards right now:
1. Registering as many new voters as we can during the **final weekend of voter registration in Arizona.**
2. Knocking **10,000 more doors** , making **20,000 more phone calls** , and sending **30,000 more text messages** to make sure everyone in our community has a plan to vote.
3. Working overtime to elect **Kamala Harris and Tim Walz** to the White House, **Ruben Gallego** to the US Senate, and pass a constitutional amendment to **protect and restore reproductive rights for every Arizonan.**

body:
We have 50 reserved seats for Tuesday Oct 8 in Spokane. | | | | | |
---
|
---
| | | |
---
|
# Debate at Gonzaga on Tues Oct 8
---
| I’m looking forward to a debate with my opponent at Gonzaga University **this Tuesday, October 8 at 5:00PM** \- hosted by The Spokesman Review/Northwest Passages, KSPS PBS, Gonzaga University, The Black Lens, and the Washington State Debate Coalition.
We would love to see friendly faces in the audience!
Tickets for the debate are free but are going fast. **However our campaign has been given 50 reserved spots**. You can sign up below, and use the code BAUM2024 to claim one of the 50 spots. (Click “Buy Now” and enter code at top right of page in the box “Enter Promo Code")
Address: Myrtle Woldson Center (Coughlin Theater), 211 E. Desmet Ave, Spokane, WA 99202
---
[GET YOUR DEBATE TICKET!](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=7f935bf672&e=5a45b9550e)
|
# Campaigning in northeast Washington
---
| We had a great time on Friday driving north to Cusick and meeting with voters at the Panther Pit Stop.
Afterwards I really appreciated visiting the Camas Center on the Kalispel Tribe reservation for a tour and a special ceremony with Congresswoman Cathy McMorris Rodgers honoring Vietnam veterans.
---
| I enjoyed stopping in to visit the Vaagen Bros. Lumber mill in Usk. If elected to Congress, I’ll be a strong advocate for our logging and timber industries, and for the rural communities that depend on them.
---
| We finished the day strong visiting with my former State Senate colleague and friend Brian Dansel and other supporters in Colville.
---
|
# Letters to the Editor
---
| Thank you to these letter writers for their endorsement!
**The Spokesman Review: Baumgartner for Congress** “Michael Baumgartner is running for the 5th District congressional seat, and he will fight for free-market solutions and champion truth, liberty and opportunity for all.Baumgartner has the experience to work with both sides of the political aisle, and will take a thoughtful, common-sense approach to reforming our broken immigration system, creating opportunity, and protecting our beautiful forests and lands all while keeping taxes low...” _Josephine Dix, Spokane_ Click [here](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=f97f9b73a2&e=5a45b9550e)
**Walla Walla Union-Bulletin: Baumgartner natural choice for district 5** “Michael Baumgartner is the natural choice for CD 5. Michael Baumgartner did a great job at the AAUW Forum at Whitman College on Tuesday, Sept. 24th. Mr. Baumgartner showed a clear plan when answering questions about drugs in our community, homelessness in our city of Walla Walla and the challenges facing our farmers in our county...” _Stephen Breithaupt, Walla Walla_ Click [here](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=d46fde6c8c&e=5a45b9550e)
If you would be willing to write a letter to the editor and would like support, please reach out to the campaign [here](mailto:eleanor@votebaumgartner.com?subject=Letter%20to%20the%20Editor&body=).
---
| We are working hard and greatly appreciate all your help!
-Michael

---
[DONATE!](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=21f75dc90c&e=5a45b9550e)

body:
"It's the Senate, Stupid." | | |
---
You've probably heard Bill Clinton's 1992 presidential campaign slogan, _"It's the Economy, Stupid."_ Clinton's political strategist, James Carville, posted it inside campaign headquarters to keep the team focussed and on the message.

The slogan is making a comeback in 2024 as Republicans highlight Kamala Harris's dismal economic record. But if you're a freedom-loving American, we have a different slogan for you.

**"It's the Senate, Stupid."**

Conservatives are rightly focused on the presidential race this year, but winning the White House – as critical as it is – won't be enough to save the country without a conservative Senate. Without the Senate, President Trump won't be able to confirm his appointees or enact his second-term agenda.
**A Republican president without a conservative Senate is simply a waste of a Republican president.**
**[**That's why we must take action right now to help elect the best Senate candidates across the nation.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=1c888d3d065943eb93911a10a81e7568&_e=JIZ7pF8kVYsoY3aj18S9ejSKrt2_oA-C5w9iY997mLpIPOzgH1jP5DIr6qQNDiNkp5sNI1Bg5K_OqvYGRRxUCrmhLTE-MK_IMYQcEfvYdd14Yyl-rGafo7dEzRNn3CsEyt9UkkaW19Kw1ckKwV8Gg-LGs03oEntOHlottMeAJaaH-dXXQtFgwqpYoR7tTHg3AWHk6BKAqlfmdTyxkYXMdA0fwv9ydVp_f_9nLlY7YCjiUx0xTorvabw_GfhBkGV7cerB-j-iCPRJlEPreCN0dw%3D%3D)**
A president can campaign on good policies, but he doesn't write the bills. As long as liberals control the Senate, good legislation will never be signed into law.

_Does anyone think Chuck Schumer will ever send bills to President Trump's desk to secure our borders, grow our economy, expand American energy, and restore election integrity?_ Of course not. If we fail to win the Senate, none of these common-sense policies will be passed. And if Kamala Harris wins, we won't be able to stop Senate Democrats from nuking the filibuster, passing their extreme agenda without debate, and creating a permanent Democrat majority.

****As we head into the final days of this election, we must support the conservatives running for U.S. Senate.**** These eight candidates believe in the principles of freedom that make America great and are willing to fight for them. They aren't liberal RINOs who will sell us out as soon as they're elected.

Updates for the 25th District - October 6th, 2024| | |
---
# **October 6th Newsletter**

---
Dear neighbors,
---
| | Phew! It has been a busy few weeks in my office which you will read about below but I want to begin this newsletter by expressing my heartbreak and well wishes to those impacted by Hurricane Helene. Let's keep the residents of western Virginia and western North Carolina in our thoughts and prayers as they navigate through this challenging period. May they find the strength and resilience to overcome the obstacles they are facing.
---
| |
---
I am grateful to the Prince William County Fire and Rescue System swift water rescue team for their diligent work supporting those impacted by the devastating floods and storm damage. On Sept. 26, the Virginia Department of Emergency Management activated the team to southwestern Virginia, where they worked alongside rescue departments from neighboring localities. Over 48 hours, the team rescued 24 people in the aftermath of Hurricane Helene.. As the impacted residents of western Virginia and western North Carolina continue to navigate this challenging period, let's keep them in our thoughts and prayers. May they find the strength and resilience to overcome the obstacles they are facing. If you would like to help support those impacted by Helene, please find ways to [donate or volunteer here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94441502/503496137/196929970?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYzExMTRlZS0yNTg0LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2A5OIPiPr-p4myJSHAZDu35_Rdvg3XTX9vW88OYBKbg=&emci=4e5794ff-1784-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=fc1114ee-2584-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=21796801) or here. In this newsletter, you will find information about my upcoming bill workshops and information about early voting. You will also find updates about the NVTA, Committee on Elementary and Secondary Education Funding, and the House Appropriations Committee.
---
| |

---
---
I am very excited to announce the dates for three upcoming bill workshops. Every bill I introduce comes from feedback or requests from residents of the 25th District, and my bill workshops are an important part of hearing from you. You can [sign up for any of our bill workshops using this link](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/94441503/503496140/1495080860?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYzExMTRlZS0yNTg0LWVmMTEtODQ3NC02MDQ1YmRhOGFhZTkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2A5OIPiPr-p4myJSHAZDu35_Rdvg3XTX9vW88OYBKbg=&emci=4e5794ff-1784-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&emdi=fc1114ee-2584-ef11-8474-6045bda8aae9&ceid=21796801) or by emailing[ joe@sewellfordelegate.com](mailto:joe@sewellfordelegate.com?subject=Del Sewell Bill Workshop RSVP "joe@sewellfordelegate.com") for more information. # Committee Updates
---
**Northern Virginia Transportation Authority:** The Northern Virginia Transportation Authority met on September 12th to discuss normal business and to review the results of the Strategic Plan. I was pleased to vote on reallocating $4 million of RSP funds to support improvements on the intersection of Old Bridge Road and Occoquan Road. These additional funds will help continue this vital project. We also heard a presentation on the results of the strategic plan, adopted in 2017. This plan set the goals of the Authority, including relevant funding and supporting sustainable transit. The Authority was excited to present that improvements from the plan yielded $7.1 billion in economic impact, 39 fully completed projects, the utilization of new data-driven transit models, and received clean audit opinions every year. With $3.8 billion being invested in 140 projects, clean audits, and an economic impact nearly double that being invested, NVTA is proud of the work this plan accomplished. I look forward to working with the Authority on the new strategic plan being adopted next year.
---
**Joint Subcommittee for Elementary and Secondary Education Funding** : On Monday, September 16th, the Joint Subcommittee on Elementary and Secondary Education Funding met in Richmond to discuss funding for our public school institutions. The Joint Legislative Audit and Review Committee (JLARC) produced a report in mid-2023 regarding Virginia’s K-12 Funding Formula. Notably, it highlighted that Virginia’s model of funding for schools was underfunding schools and underestimating the actual costs and needs of school localities in different ways. Virginia uses a staffing-based funding model, meaning that schools receive funding based on an estimated number of teachers in a district. Many other states use a student-based model, which estimates the number of students and their varying economic needs.
---
| | 50% of public school operating funding comes from residential and commercial taxes from the county. 40% of school operating funding comes from the state budget using the K-12 funding formula currently in place. Finally, 8% of the operating budget comes from the Federal government via the Department of Education. Ensuring our schools are properly funded requires good leadership at all levels of government!
---
| | One of the issues schools face is that the current funding formula tends to underestimate staff pay and needs in larger localities, which includes Prince William County. While State funding does add supplemental toward large localities, the formula still does not fully address the needs of these schools. Special education funding also currently suffers from the current formula, due to the number of special education students increasing while the funding has remained static. I look forward to finding solutions to ensure schools have all the resources they need to give our students a world-class education.
---
**House Appropriations Meeting** :On Tuesday, September 17th, the House Appropriations Committee met to hear about early childhood education, updates regarding revenues for the Commonwealth, and more. As a member of that committee, I wanted to share some of the highlights from that meeting and what it means for the residents of the 25th District. _Early Childhood Care_ This year, the House of Delegates and the State Senate allocated 1.1 billion dollars towards programs that would provide early childhood care to 75,000 Virginia families. These programs have provided care to families in need across the commonwealth, but demand is very high and many families are waitlisted. Additionally, this year we established a clear, unified standard of care system through the Department of Education (VQB5), ensuring that any care center receiving taxpayer funds provides high-quality care. This system will offer a wide range of data to help parents find the best care options available. As you may have read from previous newsletters, I have been looking for opportunities to increase access to early childhood care and education. I have been holding meetings with childcare providers and community stakeholders to work to address childcare challenges and demands. My recently passed bill to reduce red tape for military families to establish base daycare is one of many levers we have to try and ensure every family has access to affordable, quality childcare. While there is much more work to be done, I am pleased with the steps we have taken so far and look forward to finding even more ways to improve our early childhood care. _Revenue Updates_ The Secretary of Finance briefed the committee on revenues for the Commonwealth this past August and shared some slightly positive news. While August is not a large revenue month for Virginia, we saw an increase in revenues compared to 2023 and more than initial forecasts. Overall, Virginia has seen an 8% growth in general fund reserves, driven largely by higher than expected consumer spending resulting in more sales tax revenue The Secretary noted that Virginia's economy is healthy, with an unemployment rate of 2.7% and steady but modest growth. In the Secretary's words, the economy continues to “chug along”. The following infographic has a few interesting statistics about economic trends. September will likely be a more informative month, with several tax deadlines for Virginia and federal changes that may impact the Commonwealth. Keep an eye out for more updates in future newsletters.
---
| |
---
| Revenue projection formulas are based on a variety of economic indicators, taxpayer data, and estimated rates of payments and refunds. This year, Virginia has revenues that have been higher than projected. Staff have indicated that this is due to a better-than-expected economy in 2024 than was expected in 2023 when the forecast was created; good news for Virginians! This shows the challenges with trying to project tax revenue, and how even a model that is from a previous year can under or over-estimate tax revenue as our economy shifts.

Virginia uses a staffing-based funding model, meaning that schools receive funding based on an estimated number of teachers in a district. Many other states use a student-based model, which estimates the number of students and their varying economic needs. | | 50% of public school operating funding comes from residential and commercial taxes from the county. 40% of school operating funding comes from the state budget using the K-12 funding formula currently in place. Finally, 8% of the operating budget comes from the Federal government via the Department of Education. Ensuring our schools are properly funded requires good leadership at all levels of government! | | One of the issues schools face is that the current funding formula tends to underestimate staff pay and needs in larger localities, which includes Prince William County. While State funding does add supplemental toward large localities, the formula still does not fully address the needs of these schools. Special education funding also currently suffers from the current formula, due to the number of special education students increasing while the funding has remained static. I look forward to finding solutions to ensure schools have all the resources they need to give our students a world-class education. House Appropriations Meeting :On Tuesday, September 17th, the House Appropriations Committee met to hear about early childhood education, updates regarding revenues for the Commonwealth, and more. As a member of that committee, I wanted to share some of the highlights from that meeting and what it means for the residents of the 25th District. Early Childhood Care This year, the House of Delegates and the State Senate allocated 1.1 billion dollars towards programs that would provide early childhood care to 75,000 Virginia families. These programs have provided care to families in need across the commonwealth, but demand is very high and many families are waitlisted. Additionally, this year we established a clear, unified standard of care system through the Department of Education (VQB5), ensuring that any care center receiving taxpayer funds provides high-quality care. This system will offer a wide range of data to help parents find the best care options available. As you may have read from previous newsletters, I have been looking for opportunities to increase access to early childhood care and education. I have been holding meetings with childcare providers and community stakeholders to work to address childcare challenges and demands. My recently passed bill to reduce red tape for military families to establish base daycare is one of many levers we have to try and ensure every family has access to affordable, quality childcare. While there is much more work to be done, I am pleased with the steps we have taken so far and look forward to finding even more ways to improve our early childhood care. Revenue Updates The Secretary of Finance briefed the committee on revenues for the Commonwealth this past August and shared some slightly positive news. While August is not a large revenue month for Virginia, we saw an increase in revenues compared to 2023 and more than initial forecasts. Overall, Virginia has seen an 8% growth in general fund reserves, driven largely by higher than expected consumer spending resulting in more sales tax revenue The Secretary noted that Virginia's economy is healthy, with an unemployment rate of 2.7% and steady but modest growth. In the Secretary's words, the economy continues to “chug along”. The following infographic has a few interesting statistics about economic trends. September will likely be a more informative month, with several tax deadlines for Virginia and federal changes that may impact the Commonwealth. Keep an eye out for more updates in future newsletters. | | | Revenue projection formulas are based on a variety of economic indicators, taxpayer data, and estimated rates of payments and refunds. This year, Virginia has revenues that have been higher than projected. Staff have indicated that this is due to a better-than-expected economy in 2024 than was expected in 2023 when the forecast was created; good news for Virginians! This shows the challenges with trying to project tax revenue, and how even a model that is from a previous year can under or over-estimate tax revenue as our economy shifts. | | Work Zone Safety | | With multiple road construction projects occurring in the 25th district in the coming months, we will see more and more construction workers on the road. Our VDOT construction crews work hard to improve our roads, and we all need to drive carefully to ensure that they can work safely. Be sure to pay extra attention when driving in work zones, and follow the recommended safety tips from VDOT. | | | Upcoming Events In and Around the 25th District | | The Pat White Center has been a hub for the community for the . We have taken pride in providing programming, events, and spaces for community members to gather and create new experiences and memories. Join us for our Fall Festival: 50th Anniversary Celebration! That means for every $15 we raise, five new voters can be added to the rolls ahead of the 2024 elections. With the last few years' voter suppression bills defining who gets to vote and how, we have to do everything we can to make sure we get as many pro-democracy voters filling out a ballot next year as possible.
We have no hidden millionaires bankrolling us from the shadows. We're a 100% grassroots funded organization. Everything we've done to defend voting rights and register new voters has come from our supporters getting these emails and trusting us to get the job done. We're grateful for your support -- but we've got to call on you again as we ramp up for this critical election.

| In vitro fertilization, IVF, is a deeply personal issue for so many families across the country. There is no disappointment greater than learning that one is not able to have a baby.
IVF provides hope and options. It provides opportunity for a successful pregnancy and healthy baby for women who would otherwise be unable have a child. It provides others with flexibility about when to start a family.
Week of Sept. 15, the U.S. Senate failed to do the people’s business. Partisanship prevailed. Tammy Duckworth, a Democrat, and Ted Cruz, a Republican, both had bills to protect access to IVF. Neither the Democratic nor Republican versions were perfect, but then legislation never is. There were two party-line votes, followed by press conferences and finger-pointing when neither bill had enough votes to proceed.

At the time, the father-daughter duo operated a strategic consulting firm and traveled the state together on business.
Their long drives led to long conversations that included a possible future in politics for the younger Domenici.
“He would explain to me the history of different companies that he helped bring here or [talk about] the ranchers or the farmers,” she recalled. “He would just take me everywhere, so we talked about it then. But it was just more theoretical.”
Not anymore.

clean_body: Read Journal and SFNM articles... | | | | | | | | | | | Dear friends, Here are two articles that ran in New Mexico newspapers today. We thought you may be interested in having a look. Early voting in New Mexico starts Tuesday! Get out and vote, and take your friends and family with you! —Team Nella | In vitro fertilization, IVF, is a deeply personal issue for so many families across the country. There is no disappointment greater than learning that one is not able to have a baby. IVF provides hope and options. It provides opportunity for a successful pregnancy and healthy baby for women who would otherwise be unable have a child. It provides others with flexibility about when to start a family. Week of Sept. 15, the U.S. Senate failed to do the people’s business. Partisanship prevailed. Tammy Duckworth, a Democrat, and Ted Cruz, a Republican, both had bills to protect access to IVF. Neither the Democratic nor Republican versions were perfect, but then legislation never is. There were two party-line votes, followed by press conferences and finger-pointing when neither bill had enough votes to proceed. | | | Nella Domenici remembers driving around New Mexico some 20 years ago with her late father, Pete Domenici, a political giant and larger-than-life figure who still holds the title of longest-serving U.S. senator in state history. At the time, the father-daughter duo operated a strategic consulting firm and traveled the state together on business. Their long drives led to long conversations that included a possible future in politics for the younger Domenici. “He would explain to me the history of different companies that he helped bring here or [talk about] the ranchers or the farmers,” she recalled. “He would just take me everywhere, so we talked about it then. But it was just more theoretical.” Not anymore. | | | Help us spread the word about Nella’s Campaign.
